Experience providing technical guidance to electrical engineers and influencing cross-functional technical teams

jobs.title: Staff Physical Design Engineer
jobs.desc:
Senior/Staff Physical Design Engineer – Physical Implementation / PPA Optimisation / STA / TCL / Perl
We are currently partnered with a semiconductor technology organisation developing complex, high-speed designs with demanding performance, power and area (PPA) targets. This opportunity focuses on physical design implementation from floorplanning through to GDS, timing closure, power optimisation and the development of innovative methodologies and automation flows for advanced technology nodes.
Key responsibilities
Execute physical implementation for complex, high-speed designs from floorplanning through to GDS.
Research and develop innovative physical design methodologies to improve PPA and push implementation limits.
Develop scripts and flows to automate and enhance physical design processes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand design requirements and address physical implementation challenges.
Drive timing closure and power optimisation while considering congestion, routing and overall design performance.
Research industry trends and innovations in physical design to align methodologies and deliverables with best practices.
Analyse implementation data and benchmarks to identify issues, trends and opportunities for improvement.
Work across teams to identify and deliver PPA improvements while ensuring design quality and compatibility with required standards.
Key requirements
At least 4 years of relevant experience in physical design.
Knowledge of the complete physical design flow from netlist to GDS, including floorplanning, power planning, placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), routing and associated optimisation steps.
Experience with physical design implementation tools for advanced technology nodes of 10nm and below.
Strong understanding of static timing analysis (STA) and timing closure methodologies, including their impact on congestion, routing and power.
Understanding of power analysis and power integrity analysis.
Knowledge of physical verification and design rule check (DRC) closure.
Advanced automation skills using Perl and TCL, including developing and supporting physical design flows.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in cross-functional engineering teams.
Keywords
Senior Physical Design Engineer / Staff Physical Design Engineer / Physical Design / Physical Implementation / Semiconductor Design / VLSI / ASIC Design / Netlist to GDS / GDSII / Floorplanning / Power Planning / Placement / Clock Tree Synthesis / CTS / Routing / Physical Design Flow / PPA Optimisation / Power Performance Area / Timing Closure / Static Timing Analysis / STA / Timing Analysis / Congestion Analysis / Routing Optimisation / Power Optimisation / Power Analysis / Power Integrity Analysis / Physical Verification / Design Rule Check / DRC Closure / Advanced Technology Nodes / 10nm / Sub-10nm Process Technology / Physical Design Automation / TCL / Perl / Scripting / Flow Development / Flow Optimisation / High-Speed Designs / Complex Designs / Benchmark Analysis / Cross-Functional Engineering / Semiconductor Engineering

jobs.title: Financial Accountant
jobs.desc:
About the role
Reporting to the Finance Manager, the Financial Accountant will take ownership of the general ledger accounting and financial reporting for a number of operational wind farm entities. The role includes revenue accounting, balance sheet control, budgeting, management reporting, lender and covenant reporting, treasury oversight, statutory financial statements and audit management. This is an excellent opportunity for an ACA-qualified accountant to develop broad experience in a growing international renewables business.
You’ll play an important role in:
Taking ownership of general ledger accounting for operational wind farm entities, including journals, accruals, prepayments and month-end close activities.
Developing a detailed understanding of electricity market revenues and relevant government support schemes, and ensuring revenue is accurately recorded and reconciled.
Maintaining control of entity balance sheets, completing timely reconciliations and resolving reconciling items and accounting issues.
Leading the annual budget preparation process for assigned entities and supporting periodic forecasting and cash planning.
Preparing monthly management reporting, including actual-versus-budget analysis, performance commentary and clear explanations of key business drivers.
Preparing lender reporting, monitoring covenant compliance and coordinating facility repayment and debt service requirements.
Overseeing payment runs and ensuring appropriate review, approval and payment controls are maintained.
Preparing consolidated and entity statutory financial statements and managing the external audit process from interim planning through to completion and sign-off.
Building effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including management, operations, commercial teams, lenders, auditors, tax advisers and other service providers.
To succeed in the role:
ACA-qualified accountant with strong technical accounting and financial reporting capability.
Experience in general ledger accounting, month-end close, balance sheet control and account reconciliations.
Experience preparing management accounts, annual budgets and actual-versus-budget performance analysis.
The ability to understand complex revenue arrangements, interpret supporting data and communicate financial outcomes clearly.
Excellent attention to detail, a strong control mindset and the ability to manage competing priorities and reporting deadlines.
A proactive, collaborative and commercially minded approach, with strong internal and external stakeholder management skills.
Experience preparing statutory financial statements and managing or supporting the external audit process.
Experience in renewable energy, infrastructure, utilities, project finance, lender reporting or covenant compliance is advantageous.

jobs.title: Retail Artist
jobs.desc:
Retail Artist - Brown Thomas
Full Time - 30HR
Permanent Contract
About Charlotte Tilbury Beauty
Founded by British makeup artist and beauty entrepreneur Charlotte Tilbury MBE in 2013, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty has revolutionised the face of the global beauty industry by de-coding makeup applications for everyone, everywhere, with an easy-to-use, easy-to-choose, easy-to-gift range. Today, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty continues to break records across countries, channels, and categories and to scale at pace.
Over the last 10 years, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty has experienced exceptional growth and is one of the most talked about brands in the beauty industry and beyond. It has become a global sensation across 50 markets (and growing), with over 2,300 employees globally who are part of the Dream Team making the magic happen.
Today, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty is a truly global business, delivering market-leading growth, innovative retail and product launches fuelled by industry-leading tech — all with an internal culture of embracing challenges, disruptive thinking, winning together, and sharing the magic. The energy behind the bran­d is infectious, and as we grow, we are always looking for extraordinary talent who want to be part of this our success and help drive our limitless ambitions.
About The Role
You can work at a fast pace to achieve and exceed KPI's. You feed on the buzz of achieving your goals and being the best, you can be. You do not want to meet expectation - you exceed it
"Team work makes the dream work" - is your working motto. You understand your impact and how vital your role is. You can adapt to change at the last minute and be a real support to your managers and colleagues alike
You champion the art of world-class artistry and an impeccable customer experience. You are a Charlotte Tilbury brand ambassador and want to pass on your knowledge to customer after customer. You live and breathe the Charlotte Tilbury makeup looks - and can recreate the magic of these on your customer, as well as offering advice and guidance. You pride yourself on knowing your customers are returning back to you
You follow the company grooming standards to a tee - you know what good looks like and are not afraid to display this
About You
You will ideally have had some experience as a Sales Advisor. Ideally this will be gained from a fast-paced environment such as beauty, retail or FMCG
You aspire to be part of a beauty brand that disrupts the way it is seen - and continues to grow. You love all things Charlotte Tilbury - and are not afraid to spread the word
Ideally you will have experience in applying makeup - and knowing how to adapt your style to different customers with different needs
You champion positivity - and can think in a limitless way that makes your energy shine
You are required to be flexible to work on a shift basis, including both early shifts and late shifts.
You will be required to give a five-year working and personal reference, along with a Criminal Reference Check as the store is airside in the departures lounge. This will be discussed in more detail at interview stage
Why join us?
You can only be the best when you are set up to succeed - not only do we offer on the job training. We offer you the opportunity to attend Charlotte's Magic Academy - where dreams are truly made. Combining art, commerce and Charlotte's own values. You will feel truly empowered to live the magic in your role
Opportunities to disrupt processes (in a positive way!) and have your voice truly heard
The opportunity to be part of a company where we celebrate our achievements, and you are included. With a real scope for growth and progression to support your own development
You receive exclusive launches of our incredible products before anyone else - not only that you even receive a full Charlotte Tilbury look once you pass your probation. (That is right all the products from one of our iconic looks)
We also offer an incredible staff discount, and access to Tilbury Treats - our very own rewards platform allowing you to save money and gain money cannot buy discounts on anything from gym memberships to cinema tickets
At Charlotte Tilbury Beauty, our mission is to empower everybody in the world to be the most beautiful version of themselves. We celebrate and support this by encouraging and hiring people with diverse backgrounds, cultures, voices, beliefs, and perspectives into our growing global workforce. By doing so, we better serve our communities, customers, employees - and the candidates that take part in our recruitment process.
If you want to learn more about life at Charlotte Tilbury Beauty please follow our
LinkedIn page!

Familiarity with eCAD tools (e.g., Altium Designer, KiCad, or similar tools used in coursework).

General Summary
About the role
Qualcomm Technologies Inc. Global CAD team develops advanced tools, flows, methodologies, and software platforms that enable next-generation VLSI design across Qualcomm's product portfolio. This position requires deep expertise in computer science, combinatorial optimization, and scalable software architecture, combined with the ability to drive technical strategy across complex engineering domains.
You will lead the development of CAD technologies, design methodologies, and automation solutions that enable implementation flows for advanced semiconductor technologies (3nm and below). Working within a highly interdisciplinary environment spanning hardware, software, and algorithmic research, you will help define and drive innovative solutions to large-scale microelectronic design challenges through data-driven decision making and advanced optimization techniques.
Innovation is a core aspect of this role. Operating at the intersection of electronic design automation (EDA), artificial intelligence, data analytics, and software engineering, you will identify emerging opportunities, influence technical direction, and translate research concepts into production-quality solutions. We seek candidates with strong expertise in constraint reasoning, mathematical optimization, and algorithm design, coupled with demonstrated experience in building scalable software systems, driving engineering best practices, and collaborating across geographically distributed teams.
As a technical leader, you will architect and implement advanced automated reasoning frameworks to solve highly complex VLSI design challenges using techniques from artificial intelligence, constraint programming, SAT solving, mathematical optimization, integer programming, and metaheuristics. You will also provide technical mentorship, guide architectural decisions, influence roadmaps across teams, and drive the adoption of innovative methodologies that improve productivity, quality, and scalability across Qualcomm's design ecosystem.
Experience & Education We Would Love To See
Recognized technical expertise in automated reasoning, AI optimization, constraint solving, operations research, or related computational methods, with a demonstrated track record of advancing state-of-the-art solutions in complex problem domains.
Deep expertise in graph theory, combinatorial optimization, advanced data structures, and algorithmic design, with the ability to apply these concepts at scale to solve highly complex engineering challenges.
Proven ability to architect, innovate, and drive the development of next-generation constraint reasoning and optimization frameworks, delivering significant improvements in scalability, performance, and solution quality.
Demonstrated leadership in designing and delivering high-performance, production-grade software systems, establishing engineering best practices across software architecture, testing, code quality, CI/CD, observability, documentation, and long-term maintainability.
Expert-level programming skills in Python, with the ability to define technical direction, mentor engineers, and drive adoption of modern software engineering practices.
Experience leading technical initiatives across organizational boundaries, influencing roadmaps, aligning stakeholders, and driving execution in highly collaborative and multidisciplinary environments.
Strong ability to translate complex electronic design automation (EDA), semiconductor, or engineering optimization requirements into scalable algorithmic and software solutions.
Proven track record of mentoring and developing engineers, raising the technical bar of the organization through coaching, design reviews, technical leadership, and knowledge sharing.
Communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to audiences ranging from engineers and researchers to senior leadership and business stakeholders.
We Would Also Like To See
Minimum of a master’s degree in computer science, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Advanced degrees (PhD) preferred.
Relevant research contributions, publications, patents, or industry-recognized innovations are highly valued.
Experience with data science approaches and data visualisation tools for large-scale problems is a plus
Experience on C/C++ object-oriented programming, and/or experience in Synthesis or Physical Design Flows, CAD tool development is a plus

Overview
The Global CMC Regulatory Associate, Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA) Regulatory Delivery and Excellence (RD&E) is accountable for the operational and technical CMC registration management processes that support the expedited delivery of safe and effective products to patients around the world. The scope of the work includes CMC records from the beginning of clinical trials through withdrawal of the marketing application.
The Associate works within regulations to expedite the registration and lifecycle maintenance of products. The Associate will prioritise and lead the communications between our Regional Submission Associates, GRA-CMC Scientists, RD&E Specialists, and the Quality/Reg Representatives. The Associate applies CMC submission process expertise and expertise with Information Technology tools to develop project management expectations across projects. Based on implementation and supply chain needs within manufacturing, the Associate will be responsible for routine communication of submission tracking requirements to both GRA-CMC Scientists and internal customers. The scope of work includes global regulatory requirement assessment and strategy development, coordination of submissions with the RD&E specialists, and project management for marketed product support.
It is encouraged that this position accepts corporate transformation initiatives and represents GRA as a change ambassador.

Regulatory & Drug Development Expertise
Lead CMC submission management process by providing knowledge of CMC regulatory requirements, including an extensive knowledge of ICH CTD and evolving global agency standards, CMC RA submission processes, electronic submission regulations and mentorship regarding structure requirements to CMC development teams regarding global CTAs and registration dossiers. Partner with the CMC RA Scientist to drive the execution of submission planning for global registration and maintenance submissions.
Responsible for triage of Lilly affiliate inquiries and requests, and when vital, consults with CMC RA Scientist for mentorship to prepare responses to questions.
Implement and, in some cases, interpret global regulations and mentorship’s and look to regulatory precedents in submission processes and publishing standards to ensure final document content and structure are aligned with local regulatory requirements. Partner with Regional Submission Associate, as necessary, to gain alignment on establishing new submission standards to meet local agency requirements.
Partner with Regional Submission Associate to align on submission strategies and timeline for deliverables and lead communications between Regional Submission Associate, GRA-CMC scientists, RD&E specialists and Quality/Regulatory representatives.
Lead, Influence, Partner
Communicate effectively to guide and influence within work group/function and with development team regarding life-cycle management processes
Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills and ability to address and effectively communicate regulatory issues across multiple functions and geographies
Leverage internal forums to continue to develop and share regulatory and drug development expertise to meet critical product registration timelines and electronic submission structure and content requirements.
Create an environment within the Global Regulatory Area and across CMC development teams that encourages open discussions on issues to achieve a robust outcome on project decisions. Constructively challenge teams to reach the best solutions to issues.

Bachelor’s Degree in a scientific or health sciences field (e.g., pharmacy, chemistry, or related scientific discipline)
Knowledge of pharmaceutical drug development or industry-related experience preferred.

Join an award-winning graduate programme with AIB, recognised by gradireland as the ‘Most Popular Graduate Recruiter in Banking, Investment & Financial Services’ for six consecutive years and a winner of the Diversity Recruitment Award.
Work with some of Ireland's largest businesses, support major investment decisions and help shape the future of sustainable growth.
Our Capital Markets Graduate Programme offers the opportunity to develop commercial, analytical and relationship management skills while working alongside experienced professionals supporting corporate, institutional and private banking customers across Ireland and internationally.
At AIB, we know that starting your career is a big step. That's why we've created a graduate programme that gives you meaningful work, plenty of support and opportunities to develop both professionally and personally.
Over 23 months, you'll rotate across a variety of teams, gain exposure to exciting projects and develop the skills, experience and confidence needed to build a successful career.
No two days will be the same!
Why join our graduate programme?
As part of the programme, you'll gain exposure to different areas across Capital Markets, working with a wide range of teams, customers and colleagues.
You'll learn on the job, contribute to real business initiatives and work alongside experienced professionals who are invested in helping you succeed.

Build your professional network

Capital Markets serves AIB's large and medium-sized business customers as well as our private banking customers. We take a partnership approach, delivering customer-focused financing solutions and specialised products that help businesses grow, invest and achieve their ambitions.
As a Capital Markets Graduate, you'll contribute to financing solutions that help businesses expand, invest, create jobs and transition to a more sustainable future. You'll gain exposure to complex transactions and strategic client relationships from the very beginning of your career.

Support the assessment of lending and financing opportunities
Analyse financial information and market trends

Contribute to credit and risk assessment processes

Commercial Finance

Portfolio Management Unit

Ongoing classroom and online learning covering areas such as financial modelling, real estate valuation and presentation skills
On-the-job learning with some of Ireland's most experienced business lenders and relationship managers
Financial support and study leave for professional qualifications aligned to your career aspirations
A strong focus on wellbeing, inclusion and maintaining a healthy work-life balance
Every rotation will bring new opportunities to learn, challenge yourself and broaden your commercial and financial expertise.

Real project ownership from day one

Fully authorised to work in Ireland or hold a valid work permit for the full duration of the 23‑month contract (September 2027 – August 2029)

th

jobs.title: Duty Manager
jobs.desc:
The Metropole Hotel is looking for a Full Time Duty Manager to join the team on a full time basis.
Job title: Duty Manager
Reports to: Deputy General Manager/ General Manager
Your role is defined in terms of these values, as shown below:
COMMITMENT to the PASSIONATE PURSUIT OF PERFECTION:
Every team member is expected to strive for the 'Passionate Pursuit of Perfection' to ensure that the hotel guest's comfort and satisfaction is catered for in a friendly, helpful, efficient and personalised manner.
SCOPE OF WORK:
To assist in the smooth and efficient running of the hotel ensuring standards and guest satisfaction are maintained always thus ensuring revenue is maximized.
Position oversees the development and implementation of departmental strategies and ensures implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives.
MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
:
Maintaining the highest health, safety and security standards across all areas while on shift
To liaise with all HOD's daily to ensure sufficient staffing levels.
To ensure that the operation in all areas is running to the agreed standard and follow up any discrepancies with the relevant HOD's.
To assist in the daily operation of all departments as required i.e. F&B outlets, Accommodation and Front Office
To be operationally responsible for the service delivery and standards throughout the entire building when on duty.
To patrol the building ensuring that all fire exits are free from obstruction and in proper working order.
To be present around the building always during the day. In particular, the Duty Manager must maintain a lobby presence between the peak check in/out times, during lunchtime in around the lobby and restaurant and around the banqueting area during the peak tea/coffee times.
To conduct show rounds as required and have a working knowledge of C&B spaces.
To ensure that all goods and purchases are verified, documented and stored in an efficient manner.
To ensure that the highest level of cleanliness is upheld in all areas of responsibility.
Is highly visible and interfaces with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction, effectively responds to guest problems and complaints.
To actively participate in the creation of management strategies and review and update it as required.
To be operationally responsible for the service delivery and standards throughout the entire building when on duty.
Ensure that all signage throughout the building is up to date, in the correct standard and professionally displayed.
Patrol the building at regular intervals paying particular attention to cleanliness, both inside and outside the building.
To patrol the building ensuring that all fire exits are free from obstruction and in proper working order.
To take control and lead the team in the event of a fire alarm or pre-alarm scenario.
Ensure that the back of house areas are in clean and proper condition.
Ensure that the hotel is capable of achieving 100% room's occupancy and that no rooms are blocked off.
Chair the daily team briefing ensuring that all the days business is covered and any feedback is followed up.
Ensure that a comprehensive handover system is put in place to inform the Manager on Duty of all the VIP's, Complaints, Special Requests, Function Business and AOB.
To ensure that all contractors are signed in
To look after requisitions outside of store hours ensuring that all documentation is completed.
To handle all complaints in a calm, organized and discreet manner ensuring complete service recovery every time.
To get involved in and carry out training in the hotel.
To complete all projects within the required timeframe as directed by senior management.
To ensure that all relevant Duty Manager Documentation is in place.
To ensure that all necessary Duty Management documentation is compiled, recorded and stored. The Duty Manager will police this system to ensure that all HOD's covering DM shifts are trained and comply with the agreed operating procedures.
Company Benefits
Competitive rate of pay
Relocation Assistance
Access to our Company Pension Scheme
Death in Service Benefit
Employee referral bonus
Friends & Family discounts across our restaurants
Special rates in our hotel accommodation
Paid internal and external training days
Access to Trained Mental Health First Aiders
Team Member Social & Wellbeing Events
Team Member Annual Awards, Service Recognition, Monthly Team Member of The Month
Meals on Duty
Assistance with Leap Cards

Problem Solving capabilities

jobs.title: Senior or Principal Hydraulic Modeller
jobs.desc:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
Your impact
Shape the Future of Water Resilience - Dublin, Cork, Belfast
Flood risk, water security, environmental protection and climate resilience are some of the biggest infrastructure challenges facing Ireland and the UK. As a Senior or Principal Hydraulic Modeller at Jacobs, you'll play a key role in delivering the innovative solutions that help communities thrive, protect critical infrastructure and support sustainable growth for generations to come.
Join a team that's helping shape major investment programmes across Ireland's water and environmental sectors while working on projects that make a lasting difference to people and the planet.
What's In It For You
This is an opportunity to advance your technical career while working on some of the most significant water and environmental programmes in Ireland and the UK.
You'll benefit from
The opportunity to work on landmark flood risk, drainage, reservoir and water resources projects
Exposure to high-profile national frameworks and long-term strategic programmes
Clear pathways for technical and professional career progression
The chance to collaborate with industry-leading specialists across multiple disciplines
Opportunities to mentor and develop others while expanding your own leadership skills
A flexible and supportive environment that enables you to do your best work
Access to innovative tools, technologies and complex technical challenges that will accelerate your professional growth
Your Impact
As a Senior or Principal Hydraulic Modeller, you'll help deliver solutions that protect communities, improve water resilience and support sustainable infrastructure investment.
Your work will
Reduce flood risk and improve climate resilience for communities across Ireland and the UK
Support the planning and delivery of critical water and environmental infrastructure
Drive technical excellence across major multidisciplinary projects
Influence sustainable approaches to water management and environmental protection
Help develop the next generation of hydraulic modelling professionals through mentoring and technical leadership
Every project you contribute to will create tangible benefits for clients, communities and the environment.
About The Opportunity
Our Water Catchment Management team is growing rapidly, creating exciting opportunities for experienced hydraulic modellers to join us at either Senior or Principal level.
You'll become part of a collaborative, multidisciplinary team delivering a diverse portfolio of projects spanning flood risk management, drainage, water resources planning, reservoir design and environmental protection. Working closely with specialists across Jacobs, you'll support major frameworks and programmes for leading public and private sector clients throughout Ireland.
In this role, you'll
Develop, calibrate and review 1D and 1D-2D hydraulic models using industry-leading software
Apply hydrological and hydraulic analysis to solve complex water management challenges
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality outcomes for clients
Support technical assurance, peer review and quality management activities
Analyse and interpret data using GIS platforms and analytical tools
Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior team members
Contribute to project delivery from feasibility and optioneering through to detailed design and construction
Champion innovation, sustainability and continuous improvement across project delivery
Whether you're looking to deepen your technical expertise or take the next step into technical leadership, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while developing your career.
Here's what you'll need
Degree, Master's degree or equivalent qualification in Civil Engineering, Environmental Science, Geography, Mathematics or a related discipline
Experience developing and applying 1D and 2D hydraulic models for river, urban or coastal flood risk projects
Strong knowledge of hydraulic modelling software such as Flood Modeller, TUFLOW, InfoWorks ICM or HEC-RAS
Experience undertaking hydrological assessments and calculations
Ability to review and assure technical modelling outputs
A collaborative approach and passion for sharing knowledge and supporting team development
Working towards, or already holding, Chartered status with ICE, CIWEM or an equivalent professional institution
Ready to Help Build a More Resilient Future?
If you're passionate about solving complex water management challenges and want to work on projects that protect communities, strengthen infrastructure and support environmental sustainability, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply today and join Jacobs in delivering innovative water solutions that create lasting positive impact across Ireland and beyond.

We put people at the heart of our business, and we truly believe that by supporting one another through our culture of caring, we all succeed. ACA qualified, with strong technical accounting and reporting skills.
Experience of month-end close, reconciliations, and balance sheet control.
Statutory accounts and external audit experience.
Confident with management accounts, budgets, and variance analysis.

You might come from a retail liquor background, duty free, hospitality, bar work, mixology or brand ambassador experience. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Product Security
jobs.desc:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
Principal Engineer, Product Security
The Role
Analog Devices is seeking a Principal Engineer, Product Security Champion to drive product security through the full product lifecycle, from early definition through release and post-release support. This role sits inside the core security enablement team and owns day-to-day product security leadership for programs. The Security Champion serves as the central point of accountability for product security decisions, ensures the required security assurance evidence is created, works with the Product Security Assurance team and the assigned security architect, and acts as the product contact for post-release security incident response activities. The role also helps align product security goals with customer expectations, applicable standards, implementation feasibility, and long-term product support needs in alignment with the program owner.
Essential Duties And Responsibilities
Own the product security workstream for the program and serve as the primary point of accountability for security across the product lifecycle. Products in scope are: digital and mixed signal chips, modules, subsystems and software.
Define and maintain the product security posture, including product-level security requirements, objectives, and supporting assumptions.
Ensure the evidence is created to demonstrate that security assurance practices are followed during development.
Act as the main point of contact with the Product Security Assurance team and the assigned Security Advisor for development-phase security questions and assurance activities.
Shape security requirements, architecture decisions, threat analysis inputs, and security IP selection.
Align with the product owner, product architect, software teams, and engineering stakeholders so security decisions fit the product scope, architecture, cost, schedule, and intended use.
Engage key customers when needed to validate security objectives, threat assumptions, and expected security posture for the target application.
Drive compliance planning and execution for applicable standards, regulations, certifications, and Secure Development Life Cycle deliverables.
Oversee security implementation, secure development practices, verification activities, provisioning-related security actions, and product security continuity after release.
Act as the product point of contact for post-release security incident response activities and organize response actions when vulnerabilities or incidents arise.
Maintain continuity of security through product lifetime, including support for remediation, maintenance obligations, and end-of-life security activities.
Minimum Qualifications
Completion of security training or certification
Demonstrated ~10 year experience to secure development processes, product security implementation, and security assurance practices in product programs following established standards.
Working knowledge of relevant standards, regulatory frameworks, and industry security practices applicable to the target market (e.g. IEC62443, ISO21434, US FDA, EU CRA).
Strong understanding of security requirements and how they apply at the product level: hardware System-on-Chip architectures, Secure Boot, Hardware cryptography, Embedded Software security. 3+ years of experience in silicon SoC security architecture and design preferred.
Solid technical background spanning software, hardware, network and cloud security attached to embedded or connected products.
Ability to work effectively across product, architecture, software, hardware, quality, and assurance teams.
Additional Skills, Knowledge And Abilities
Ability to explain security decisions clearly and build trust with internal stakeholders and customers.
Ability to translate market, customer, and regulatory inputs into actionable product security requirements and plans.
Ability to manage long-lived security ownership, including compliance evidence, certifications, and post-release maintenance expectations or products.
Comfort operating in cross-functional product teams where security cuts across architecture, implementation, verification, manufacturing, and operational support.
For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.
Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.

jobs.title: Android Applications Developer
jobs.desc:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
Department Overview
Department Description
Innovation is the oxygen of our company, and in 2023, we invested more than US$850 million in research and development (R&D). We’re now opening a new Research & Development Centre in Cork, Ireland focused on designing software for the company’s comprehensive land mobile radio (LMR) portfolio, with plans for expansion across other technologies in the future.
Motorola Solutions’ ecosystem of technologies is centred on safety and security, with LMR representing a foundational core. The company has deployed more than 13,000 LMR networks worldwide, trusted by governments and enterprises for highly secure communications designed to work in the most extreme conditions. Modernised with broadband and advanced data applications, LMR remains at the forefront of providing public safety agencies with the communications they rely on and need.
You’ll be part of our diverse and experienced global team, developing meaningful solutions that support thousands of public safety agencies and enterprises worldwide in solving complex safety and security challenges. Come join our team to work on real-world projects with a real-world impact.
Job Description
We are seeking an experienced Senior Android Applications Developer to design, build, and maintain mission-critical Android applications supporting public-safety communication, situational awareness, and operational data systems. These applications are used by emergency responders and must operate reliably in demanding field environments with intermittent connectivity, device integrations, and high availability requirements.
The successful candidate will collaborate with product management, UI/UX, backend platform teams, and device integration teams to deliver secure, resilient, and performance-optimized applications, while driving engineering excellence, architectural consistency, and technical mentorship across the organization.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain mission-critical Android applications using Kotlin-first development practices.
Implement resilient, offline-capable, and fault-tolerant mobile solutions capable of operating in low-connectivity or degraded network environments.
Build modern Android user interfaces using Jetpack Compose while ensuring usability in high-stress operational workflows.
Implement scalable, modular architectures (e.g., MVVM, Clean Architecture, modularization) supporting large multi-feature applications.
Integrate with backend systems, real-time messaging platforms, and device services using REST, streaming, and event-driven APIs.
Develop and maintain integrations with Bluetooth, radio communication interfaces, sensors, GPS/location, and background services.
Optimize applications for performance, battery efficiency, and reliability under continuous operational use.
Implement secure communication, authentication, and data-protection mechanisms aligned with enterprise and public-safety security requirements.
Contribute to automated testing, reliability validation, and release quality gates including unit, integration, and instrumentation testing.
Support CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and operational monitoring of deployed mobile applications.
Participate in technical design reviews, mentor engineers, and promote engineering best practices across teams.
Diagnose field issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement durable fixes for production deployments.
Basic Requirements
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong experience developing production Android applications using Kotlin and the Android SDK.
Experience designing high-reliability, enterprise, or mission-critical mobile applications.
Experience with modern Android UI development using Jetpack Compose.
Strong knowledge of Android architecture components (ViewModel, Navigation, Lifecycle, WorkManager).
Experience implementing offline-first data synchronization, caching, and conflict-handling strategies.
Experience working with Bluetooth, device integrations, background processing, or hardware-adjacent APIs.
Experience with networking frameworks such as Retrofit, OkHttp, or Ktor.
Strong debugging, performance optimization, and secure coding practices.
Experience working with Git-based development workflows.
Strong collaboration and communication skills within cross-functional engineering environments.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working on public safety, communications, defense, or highly regulated enterprise mobile platforms.
Experience integrating with radio communication systems, push-to-talk, messaging, or real-time communication frameworks.
Experience implementing secure mobile architectures including certificate-based authentication, encrypted storage, and hardened builds.
Experience with dependency injection frameworks (Hilt/Dagger).
Familiarity with modular Android architectures for large-scale applications.
Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical initiatives.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments supporting multi-team product releases.
Familiarity with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) for sharing business logic across mobile or cross-platform applications.
Familiarity with Compose Multiplatform for building shared UI components across Android and other supported platforms.
Experience with Firebase, observability platforms, or operational telemetry tooling.

Experienced

jobs.title: Structural Simulation Engineer
jobs.desc:
Responsibilities
The Structural Simulation Engineer will support the structural design and development of Liebherr container cranes through Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and simulation activities. The primary focus of the role will be the assessment and optimisation of crane components and structures using Ansys, including both static and transient/dynamic simulations.
The successful candidate will also have the opportunity to develop skills in multi-body dynamics modelling and control system simulation using MATLAB/Simulink and Simscape Multibody, working closely with structural, automation and control engineering teams.
Key Elements of the Role:
Responsibilities shall include, but are not limited to the following:
Perform structural analysis of crane components and assemblies using the Ansys suite of software.
Conduct static, nonlinear and transient dynamic simulations to support product development and verifi-cation activities.
Evaluate structural strength, stiffness, fatigue performance and dynamic behaviour of crane structures and mechanical systems.
Prepare, review and interpret finite element models, simulation results and technical reports.
Support the development and validation of simulation methodologies and best practices within the de-partment.
Collaborate with design engineers to improve component and system performance through simulation-led design.
Develop and maintain simplified and detailed simulation models for complex mechanical systems.
Support the modelling of crane mechanisms using MATLAB/Simulink and Simscape Multibody.
Collaborate with automation and control engineers to understand the interaction between mechanical systems and control algorithms.
Contribute to the development of simulation tools, automation workflows and engineering processes us-ing Python, Ansys APDL and VBA.
Work with CAD models generated in PTC Creo and prepare geometry for simulation activities.
Constructively collaborate with the simulation engineering community within MCC and the broader Liebherr Group.
Qualifications, Requirements & Experience
The successful candidate will hold a third-level qualification in an engineering discipline – preferably L9 or L10.
A strong interest in engineering simulation, numerical methods and analytical problem solving.
Knowledge of Finite Element Analysis principles is essential.
Experience with Ansys Mechanical or similar FEA software is desirable.
Knowledge of structural mechanics, strength of materials and dynamics.
Exposure to transient or dynamic analysis methods would be advantageous.
Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, Simscape Multibody or similar modelling environments would be advantageous.
Experience with CAD software, particularly PTC Creo, would be beneficial.
Basic programming skills are desirable, with Python considered a significant advantage.
Demonstrated aptitude for learning new software tools, simulation techniques and engineering methodologies.

Sanitation Lead - Charleville
About The Role
Here at Kinisla, we're currently recruiting for a Sanitation Lead to join our team in Charleville, Co. Cork. The successful candidate will become an integral part of our Quality and Production Department, working alongside experienced teammates to help improve plant performance.
This is an internal role only.
What will I be doing?
Work closely with both the production and quality team making sure product safety is always the number 1 priority.
Inspection of the manufacturing process to determine compliance to sanitation protocols.
Maintain a clean, safe, and sanitized area.
Perform routine inspections of the manufacturing facility during production and cleaning. Report any irregularities.
Provide feedback to Quality and Operations management.
Implement corrective actions to ensure compliance with site procedures.
Monitor the preparation and use of cleaning chemicals (Chemical concentration on boot wash, Chlorous etc, is correct during production and caustic checks on the wash).
Oversee all material movements into the high care facility confirming these materials are sanitized, swabbed and movements are compliant with site procedures.
Ensure floors are clean, sanitized, and free from product.
Sanitise high risk touch points - Townsend doors, handrails, touch screens and legs of equipment.
Maintain and document hygiene of drains - cleaning and treating as required and compliance to site procedures.
Report all leaks in the high-risk area to maintenance and technical for repair. Elevate to the Operations and Quality Teams if these maintenance repairs are not actioned in a timely manner.
Complete shift sanitation handover log.
Perform routine inspections of footwear PPE and report any issues to the Quality and Operations management teams.
Visually inspect, sign off and release facility and equipment into manufacture on satisfactory completion of wash activities.
Collaborate with maintenance and TL on risk assessing interventions during production activities.
Prepare pipes for twister changeovers.
Actively participate in inspections and audits.
Carry out post wash swabs in compliance with site procedures.
Any other duties as required.
What do I need to be successful?
Responsible for the cleanliness and sanitation of the facility.
Practice and oversee proper cleaning and sanitation techniques.
The Sanitation Lead is expected to be an active participant in all aspects of the QA and Production processes, from ingredient preparation, cooking, manufacturing, and packaging of product.
Responsible for compliance to sanitation protocols in line with site procedures and protocols. Conduct daily sanitation inspections, and address / escalate any negative findings.
Demonstrate strong leadership skills, good knowledge of the food industry, and a good eye for detail.
Ensures the manufacturing facility is always maintained to the highest levels of hygiene.
Full training will be provided on all aspects of this role to the successful candidate.
About Kinisla
Kinisla is a vertically integrated farm-to-fork business with a very substantial consumer foods presence and a leading nutritional and dairy ingredients division, delivering high-quality dairy solutions with a focus on sustainability and innovation. From partnering with local family farms to producing world-class dairy products, we ensure every step of our value chain reflects our commitment to excellence.
With over 50 years’ experience in milk processing, dairy and nutritional technology advancement, and product innovation, we are a key stakeholder in the global food industry and creators of a strong portfolio of market leading dairy brands including Cheestrings, Charleville and Coleraine Cheese, Dairygold, Golden Cow and our new SMUG range. Our from food, for food culture and deep-rooted connection to our 2,800 milk suppliers differentiates our business and offers captivating opportunities for our customers and consumers.
Our dairy comes from some of the world’s richest grazing land and is produced by a network of Irish family farms that have one of the lowest carbon footprints in the world. Through a combination of expertise, innovation, and sustainability, Kinisla is proud to shape the future of dairy while meeting the diverse needs of our farmers, customers, and communities.
Headquartered in Tralee, Co. Kerry, we operate multiple manufacturing facilities in the southwest of Ireland, including Listowel, Charleville, Newmarket, and Farranfore. Additionally, we manage 28 Farm & Home stores throughout the region, ensuring comprehensive coverage and service. In Northern Ireland and the United Kingdom, our presence extends to key locations in Portadown, Coleraine, and Ossett.
Globally, Kinisla employs over 1,700 dedicated professionals across Ireland, Northern Ireland, the UK, USA, Netherlands, Spain, Germany, and China. In 2024, we achieved a turnover of approximately €1.3 billion, reflecting our commitment to excellence and growth.

One culture where everyone brings their unique perspectives and experiences to help make us better, together. A RF Power Electronics Engineer is required by CareerWise Recruitment to join our based Cork based MN medical device client. Working within a multi-disciplinary R&D team you have responsibility for new product and process development. Permanent role.
Role
* Design, develop, refine and evaluate electrical components, assemblies and subsystems for electrosurgery medical devices.
* Lead the design and implementation of high-energy electrical subsystems for patient-connected medical devices.
* Translate user, clinical and system-level needs into electrical requirements, specifications and system designs.
* Apply concurrent engineering, rapid prototyping and advanced testing methods to accelerate product development while meeting cost, quality and compliance requirements.
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring and training to team members on product commercialisation, design trade-offs, technology development and complex engineering challenges.
* Contribute to customer-focused design, voice-of-customer activities, competitive strategy and market understanding in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
* Lead and contribute to engineering documentation, Design History File (DHF) content, R&D procedures and standards-based development activities.

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, with at least 6 years of relevant experience.
* Advanced electrical design expertise across complex components and electronic subsystems for medical devices.
* Strong experience in high-frequency power electronics operating from hundreds of kHz to low MHz frequencies, including resonant and quasi-resonant topologies, custom magnetics, high-voltage DC/DC converters and power amplifiers.
* Hands-on experience designing custom magnetics, including high-frequency isolation transformers.
* Strong understanding of RF engineering, electromagnetics, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), measurement systems, sensing and control interfaces, particularly in high dv/dt and high common-mode noise environments.
* Proven ability to guide testing, troubleshooting, PCB and cable design, electrical stack-ups, statistical analysis, and manufacturing and test methods.

jobs.title: Short-term Temporary Team Member - Cork Mahon (N129830)
jobs.desc:
Job Description
SHIFTS YOU ARE APPLYING FOR:
8.50hrs p/w; Mon 09:30 - 14:15; Tue 08:00 - 12:00
Join Our Team This Autumn/Winter
Join our store teams this Autumn/Winter and help us deliver an incredible experience for our customers. Contracts range from a few days to several months, depending on store needs, making this an ideal opportunity if you're looking for flexible seasonal work.
Life at NEXT is full of energy, with a strong sense of teamwork and plenty of opportunities to learn, grow, and develop new skills.
Contract details:
It is anticipated the fixed term contracts will range from 1 or 2 days up to 24 weeks in duration. The individual store will confirm the exact duration available during the application process.
Please note:
Availability for our Autumn Sale weekend (Friday 18th September and Saturday 19th September) and our Winter Sale (Thursday 24th December, Sunday 27th December and Monday 28th December) may be required, depending on your start date, contract duration and store needs.
What You’ll Do
As part of our in-store team, you’ll work on the sales floor, in the stockroom, or across both areas, playing an important role in keeping the store running smoothly during our busy Autumn/Winter season. Every shift makes a difference in this high-energy retail environment, helping us deliver an exceptional experience for our customers.
On the sales floor, you’ll:
Deliver fast, friendly service and help customers find what they need
Keep the sales floor well stocked, organised, and easy to shop
Ensure the shop floor is clean, tidy, and visually appealing
In the stockroom, you’ll:
Efficiently process deliveries and replenish the sales floor to ensure it remains fully stocked and presentable
Pick, pack, and transfer stock to meet customer timescales and ensure accurate parcel processing
Keep the back of house clean, safe and organised
Where needed, you
may support both areas
.
What You’ll Bring
To succeed in this role, you will be:
Friendly and approachable, always happy to help
A team player who stays calm in busy moments
Reliable, organised, and ready to get involved
Keen to learn and take pride in doing a great job
Respectful, committed and eager to play your part
If you’re looking for an engaging, hands-on role this season, we’d love to hear from you.
Why join us?
Alongside the great benefits listed below, you’ll also enjoy:
Flexible, short-term contracts
A welcoming and inclusive team environment
First pick of Sale stock (if working during the event)
Sound like you?
Apply now to be part of our team.
We encourage you to apply early, as candidates are reviewed on an ongoing basis and the advert may close once sufficient applications have been received.
Successful candidates will be required to evidence their right to work before commencement of employment.
About Us
You know Next, but did you know we’re a FTSE-100 retail company employing over 44,000 people across the Next group. We’re the UK’s 2nd largest fashion retailer and for Kidswear we’re the market leader. At the last count we have over 450 stores, plus the Next Online and it’s now possible to buy on-line from over 80 countries around the world! So we’ve gone global!
About The Team
Recognition and rewards for doing a great job and achieving great results (after 1 week's service)
25% off most NEXT, MADE*, Lipsy*, Gap* and Victoria's Secret* products (*when purchased through NEXT)
10% off most partner brands & up to 15% off Branded Beauty (after 1 week's service)
60% off a generous (optional) working wardrobe allowance to buy clothes to wear for work (minimum 6 week contract)
Early VIP access to sale stock
Free health and wellbeing services
Support Networks - Access to Network Groups to empower and celebrate each other
Conditions apply to all benefits. These benefits are discretionary and subject to change.
We aim to support all candidates during the application process and are happy to provide workplace adjustments when necessary. Should you need support with your application due to a disability or long-term condition, feel free to get in touch with us by email careers@next.co.uk (please include 'Workplace Adjustments' in the subject line), or call us on 0116 479 2223 / 0044 116 479 2223 (line opening times are Monday to Thursday 9am - 5pm; Friday 9am - 4.45pm; Saturday 9am - 5pm & Sunday 9am - 4pm. Excludes bank holidays).

jobs.title: Christmas Customer Assistant
jobs.desc:
Please note, this role is located in IRELAND
Ready to make someone's day this Christmas? Join Boots as a Seasonal Customer Assistant and be part of something special.
The festive season at Boots is one of the busiest and most exciting times of the year, and we're looking for enthusiastic people to help create brilliant experiences for our customers when it matters most.
About The Opportunity
As a Seasonal Customer Assistant, you'll be at the heart of the action, helping customers find the perfect gift, discover great offers and get what they need for the celebrations ahead.
You'll be the friendly face customers turn to for advice and support, creating feel-good moments that make a real difference and keep them coming back all year round.
This is an important role where you'll help deliver a great experience for our customers. It's also a fast-paced and active role where priorities can change quickly throughout the day.
You won't just be helping customers on the shop floor. You'll also support deliveries, replenish stock, and help keep the store looking its best.
Working in store is a real team effort, so you'll need to be flexible and ready to step into different areas to keep things running smoothly. You'll feel good knowing you're playing your part and enjoy a strong sense of teamwork and fun as everyone pulls together during our busiest season.
If you enjoy helping people, staying busy and being part of a supportive team, this could be the role for you.
This is a temporary role, with the potential for longer-term opportunities depending on local availability.
You Will
What you'll be doing
Welcome customers, understand their needs and help them find the right products, gifts, services and offers.
Create memorable customer experiences through friendly, personalised service.
Help customers complete purchases using tills and self-checkouts.
Replenish stock and keep shelves full
Support deliveries and help organise stock in the stockroom.
Keep the store and shopping areas look their best.
Work across different areas of the store and support your team wherever help is needed.
What You'll Need To Have (our Must-haves)
Available to work Bank Holidays including Black Friday week and weekend, Cyber Monday, Christmas Eve, St Stephen's Day and New Year's Day.
Customer-focused — enjoys talking to people and helping customers have a great experience.
Team player — supports others and cares about team success.
Operations ready — comfortable balancing customer service with stock, fulfilment and shop floor tasks.
Proactive attitude — sees what needs doing and takes ownership.
Resilient — stays positive and focused during busy periods.
Energy and stamina — keeps energy high throughout long, active shifts.
Confident asking questions — asks for help when needed to get things right.
Comfortable with technology — learns new systems and confidently uses handheld devices, tills and self-checkouts.
It would be great if you also have
Previous experience in a retail or customer-facing environment.
Familiarity with Boots products and services.
Where your brilliance can take you
You’ll receive industry-recognised training and build valuable experience along the way. You may go on to explore more in Retail, Pharmacy, Beauty or Opticians, or ultimately progress into management. There are plenty of paths to follow for you to become brilliant with Boots —you can read some of our
colleagues stories here.
Rewards designed for you
Discretionary Christmas bonus
Generous employee discount (After 1 month’s service)
Access to our One Hub discount platform
There’s lots more in our benefits and discounts, MyBoosts – there to give you that little lift in your everyday. Find out more at
boots.jobs/ireland
Exclusions may apply; eligible roles only. Please note that any salary estimates provided on third-party sites are not endorsed by Boots and may not be accurate.
A Bit About Us
At Boots, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, creating a place where everyone feels welcome, supported, and free to be themselves. We believe that when our people feel valued and included, they thrive, so we're committed to creating a brilliant Boots for our people so they can make a difference for our customers and colleagues every time.
What’s next?
If you apply, our team will be in touch to let you know the outcome of your application or to arrange next steps. Where a role is advertised as full-time, we are open to discussing part-time and job share options.
If you require additional support as part of the application and interview process, we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments to help you be at your best.
We hope to hear from you soon.
Be brilliant with Boots.

jobs.title: Beauty Sales Specialist
jobs.desc:
Are you a beauty expert who loves connecting with people and delivering unforgettable experiences? Ready to take your skills beyond the high street and see the world while you work?
At Harding+, we create retail experiences that travel. Working at sea, you’ll meet customers from every corner of the globe, building genuine connections and delivering moments they’ll remember long after their holiday ends. We partner with leading cruise lines and global brands to create retail experiences that stand out—recognised by winning
Cruise Retailer of the Year in 2022, 2023 and 2025
.
A role where no two days feel the same
Life on board is fast-moving, social and full of variety. One day you could be helping a guest find their perfect fragrance; the next, hosting a beauty event or supporting a makeover that transforms someone’s evening.
You’ll use your product knowledge and natural confidence with people to create a warm, personalised experience, understanding what each customer needs and bringing our brands to life in an engaging and authentic way.
You won’t be doing this alone. You’ll be part of a supportive onboard team, learning together, sharing successes, and building skills that will stay with you throughout your career.
What You’ll Bring
You’ll already have experience working in beauty, alongside a background in retail or sales in a customer-facing environment. This means you’re confident recommending products, understanding customer needs, and delivering a high standard of service.
You know how to build rapport quickly, start conversations with ease, and guide customers towards the right purchase in a way that feels natural and personalised.
We’re looking for someone who is motivated to keep learning and developing. You don’t need to know every brand inside out but you should be curious, open to feedback, and willing to step outside your comfort zone. That could be demonstrating products, supporting in-store events, or speaking to small groups.
You’ll also bring a positive, team-focused mindset and the adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where every day is different.
What You’ll Gain
This is more than a job it’s an experience that builds both your confidence and your career.
Competitive salary with generous commission- all take home pay
Included Accommodation and meals provided onboard
No household bills while you are working at sea
Support with necessary visas and seafaring documents
Dedicated in-house training across sales, product and brand knowledgeThe opportunity to travel the world while earning
Contracts of up to 6 months onboard, usually followed by 1 to 2 months at home between contracts
On selected cruise lines, the opportunity to travel independently after your contract, with support for your return travel home afterwards

Information about the Organisation:
The Local Enterprise Offices (LEOs) of Cork County Council lead a strategic programme to strengthen entrepreneurship, accelerate small business growth, and foster an inclusive, resilient local economy across Cork’s towns and rural hinterlands.
There are 31 Local Enterprise Offices (LEO) in Ireland, each available to facilitate access to enterprise services and to promote and support enterprise at a local level. The LEO is the First Stop Shop for anyone seeking information and support on starting or growing a business in Ireland. Each LEO is led by a Head of Enterprise.
Cork County Council has two LEO – Cork North & West, and Cork South.
County Cork has a population of approximately 359,000 citizens. The county is served by 55 elected members representing the populations of its 8 Municipal Districts, Carrigaline (6), Bandon/Kinsale (6), Macroom (6), Cobh (6), East Cork (7), Fermoy (6), Kanturk/Mallow (9) and West Cork (9) and has the largest elected assembly outside of Dublin.
County Cork covers an area of 7,318 square kilometres, which is 11% of the Irish State and makes Cork Ireland's largest county. With 12,211 km of public roads, Cork County Council's transportation network equates to 13.5% of the nation's total. The Council’s Capital Investment Programme for 2023-2025 is €1.3 billion, indicating the extent of its impact across all aspects of life in Cork County.
An opportunity now exists in Cork County Council for the position of Head of Enterprise.
Job Summary/Description:
The Head of Enterprise is a senior role within the Economic Development and Strategic Planning Directorate of Cork County Council. The Head of Enterprise will lead a team charged with delivering a high standard quality system of coordinated and cohesive State support to the micro and small business sector. This is a key position within the Local Enterprise Office (LEO) structure of the Local Authority. The successful candidate will be required to make a significant contribution to the development and implementation of a strategic plan to support enterprise, entrepreneurship and job creation at a local level. Success will be measured by ensuring that the LEO serves as a First Stop Shop to provide services to start, grow and develop micro and small business throughout the County.
A full list of essential requirements is available in the Information Booklet.

About the role
We pride ourselves on offering customers the biggest range of products around. And that's not just food, but everything from clothes and kettles to financial services.
But did you know we offer the biggest job opportunities too? With stores across the UK and Ireland, and a variety of roles, we are always looking for people who are as passionate about helping customers as we are.
Our Every Little Helps approach doesn't just apply to our customers. It's at the very heart of everything we do at work - and it's what makes us different. We believe in treating each other with respect, and everyone having the opportunity to get on. That's what makes Tesco such a great place to work.
Should you be successful in your application, your offer will be subject to and conditional upon you providing your bank account details before your agreed start date.

Able to give great, natural customer service by proactively smiling, greeting, acknowledging and helping customers.
Works hard for customers, your team and your department.
You are able to prioritise to ensure anything you do is right for our customers.
Adaptable and resilient to meet the ever changing demands of our business.
You must be able to follow instructions either verbal or written.
You are reliable and a good timekeeper.
You must be smart and tidy at all times.
Whats in it for you?
We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren't limited to:
Competitive Salary
Bonus Scheme*
Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost.
24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life.
Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2nd Clubcard available.*
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*
Save As You Earn Scheme*
Paid Family Leave
Bike to Work
Long Service Awards
Commuter Scheme
*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply
About Us
Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer's favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move. Our core purpose is "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day". Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers. It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children's Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best.
We know life looks a little different for each of us. That's why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.
Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco-careers.com/accessibility/

Please let us know you need additional support by emailing tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie
This will allow us to understand more about you and how we can best support you through the recruitment process.

jobs.title: STA Design Engineer
jobs.desc:
We are looking for an experienced
Static Timing Analysis (STA) Engineer
to join a world-leading semiconductor company developing next-generation, high-performance, low-power SoCs. You'll play a key role in timing signoff, timing closure and methodology development, working closely with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver cutting-edge silicon.
As an STA Engineer, you will be responsible for performing static timing analysis, developing and validating timing constraints, and driving timing closure across complex ASICs and SoCs. Working with RTL, Synthesis and Physical Design teams, you'll help optimise performance, power and area while ensuring designs meet timing signoff requirements.
Responsibilities
Perform static timing analysis and timing closure for complex cores and full-chip SoCs.
Develop and improve STA methodologies, flows and timing signoff processes.
Drive timing accuracy while improving static and dynamic analysis turnaround times.
Ensure designs meet timing signoff criteria and project quality standards.
Develop automation for timing and power data collection, processing and analysis.
Support project planning by contributing to technical milestones and deliverables.
Deliver project objectives on schedule while providing production support when required.
Troubleshoot and resolve timing-related issues throughout the development lifecycle.
Requirements
Experience using STA tools such as PrimeTime, PrimeShield or Tempus for hierarchical timing analysis on large SoCs.
Hands-on experience with timing ECO tools including Tweaker, PrimeClosure, PTECO or Tempus ECO.
