Based 3 days on site in Cork, Ireland **
Job Description
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
The Role:
The Brand Protection Manager is responsible for safeguarding the company’s brand integrity across European markets by identifying, investigating, and mitigating risks related to unauthorized distribution, parallel trade, non-compliant SKUs, and abuse of commercial programs. This role works cross-functionally with Legal, Sales, Supply Chain, and external partners to enforce brand standards and protect revenue, reputation, and customer trust.
Key Responsibilities:
Parallel Trade Monitoring & Control
Monitor and analyze parallel trade activities across EU markets.
Identify unauthorized distribution channels and gray market activities.
Develop and implement strategies to minimize revenue leakage caused by parallel imports/exports.
Collaborate with regional teams to enforce territorial distribution agreements.
Non-Compliant SKU Management
Detect and investigate genuinely non-compliant, altered, or counterfeit SKUs in the market.
Ensure adherence to product specifications, labeling regulations, and applicable EU regulatory standards.
Partner with Regulatory Affairs and Quality teams to assess and address verified product deviations.
Lead corrective actions where required, including product withdrawal, remediation, or enforcement measures based on objective compliance or IP concerns.
Investigations & Enforcement
Design and implement monitoring systems to Identify and investigate misuse of company programs (e.g., promotions, end user discounts, rebates, distributor incentives), focusing on fraud, misreporting, or contractual misuse.
Conduct audits and reviews of high-risk activities to ensure proper program execution.
Collaborate with Finance, Trade Compliance and Legal to address confirmed cases and mitigate financial impact.
Data Analysis & Reporting
Analyze sales data, distribution flows, and market trends to identify anomalies, risks, and opportunities.
Develop dashboards and KPIs to monitor brand protection, compliance risks, and program integrity.
Provide regular reports and actionable insights to senior management to support informed, compliant decision-making.
External Partner Management
Manage relationships with third-party investigators, brand protection agencies, and legal counsel.
Oversee vendor performance and ensure alignment with company policies and EU legal frameworks.
Ensure all external activities are conducted in compliance with applicable laws and internal standards.
Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:
Execute Distribution Strategy: Implement the EU distribution sales strategy, aligning with company objectives to drive market growth and optimize partner performance.
Build and Manage Partnerships: Foster strong relationships with distributors by integrating digital tools, enhancing their sales capabilities, and driving collaborative success.
Analyze and Optimize Performance: Monitor distribution performance, identify growth opportunities, optimize SLAs, and address operational challenges efficiently.
Support Marketing Initiatives: Align marketing and promotional strategies to enhance distributor brand visibility, product uptake, and market presence.
Collaborate and Drive Insights: Work cross-functionally within the organization to develop actionable insights, support partner training, and adopt innovative distribution technologies.
Key Qualifications:
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviours to our team:
5+ years of experience in brand protection, compliance, anti-counterfeiting, or distribution control.
Strong understanding of EU trade regulations, parallel trade dynamics, and compliance requirements.
Experience with investigations, audits, and enforcement actions.
Analytical mindset with proficiency in data analysis tools (Excel, BI tools).
Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.
Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!
We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, age, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

Our values are important to us, and shape how we work, how we treat each other and how we recognise excellence.
At ALS, you’ll be supported to develop new skills and reach your full potential. We invest in our people with programs and opportunities that help you build a diverse career with us.
We want everyone to have a safe, flexible and rewarding career that makes a positive impact on our people, the planet and our communities.
Everyone Matters
ALS is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where the strengths and perspectives of each employee are both recognised and valued.
ALS also welcomes applications from people with all levels of ability. Reasonable adjustments to support candidates throughout the recruitment process are available upon request.
Eligibility
To be eligible to work at ALS you must be a Citizen or Permanent Resident of the country you are applying for, or either hold or be able to obtain, a valid working visa.
How To Apply
Please apply on-line and provide a resume & cover letter that best demonstrate your motivation and ability to meet the requirements of this role.

jobs.title: Research Assistant- AI assisted design ICs capture BioSignals
jobs.desc:
Research Assistant- AI assisted design ICs capture BioSignals
About Tyndall
Tyndall National Institute is an international leader in semiconductors, photonics and deep-tech research and innovation. As a leading collaborative European research institute, Tyndall is a key actor and hosting partner in the delivery of the ‘Chips for Europe Initiative’ (EU Chips Act).
Tyndall is Ireland’s leading research and innovation organisation and it is the national focal point for excellence in deep-tech research, development and graduate training at the convergence of nanotechnology, microelectronics, photonics, electronics and AI. Tyndall is recognised as an international research leader in semiconductor, chip and digital technologies, particularly as applied to the fields of Information & Communications, Health & Life Sciences, Agritech & Food Security, Energy and Climate Mitigation, emerging fields such as quantum, and novel computing paradigms.
The Institute’s key objective is to see frontier research activities having a significant impact on economic development and societal challenges in Ireland, Europe and beyond. Central to Tyndall’s mission is delivering economic impact through research excellence in partnership with industry and academia. With an annual turnover of more than €50m, the Institute has a community of over 600 researchers, engineers, support staff, postgraduate students, interns and industry researchers-in-residence.
With significant committed Irish government support, Tyndall will grow to be 1,000 people by 2030, with approximately 750 researchers, including 250 PhD students. A new 17,000 m2 research building is under development adjacent to the Cork headquarters and there are developing plans to expand Tyndall’s existing Dublin research labs and to establish other research sites within Ireland.
Tyndall’s expansion is also supported by recent national and EU funding wins for significant (M€10’s) additional research equipment across a range of areas such as semiconductor processing, microscopy, quantum technologies, heterogeneous integration, ultra-high speed optical communications and RF through THz characterisation.
About the Team
The integrated circuits group at Tyndall National Institute consist of a large team of researchers in silicon chip design, at various stages of their careers; from Masters researcher through to Principal Researcher. All are creating advanced, innovative and high impact Integrated Circuit technologies, which will shape our future lives. Excellent research is being carried out in areas such as Analog Precision Circuits, RF and Millimeter-wave Communications circuits, Cryogenic CMOS and Integrated Power Systems.
About the Role
Design of a Wide-bandwidth (RF) low noise amplifier
The objective of this position is to apply AI assisted circuit design methods to design amplifiers and Analog to Digital converter blocks. The circuit blocks will be used to build a system to capture Bio electrical signals like ECG and EMG.
Key Duties & Responsibilities
The candidate is expected to be creative, self-motivated, and should help create an efficientl and friendly atmosphere within the Integrated Circuits Group and beyond to all teams at Tyndall.
Propose AI assisted design methods to Simulate, Design and Layout analogue circuits either using Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools from industry standard vendors like Cadence or custom or open source tools
With guidance from the senior Tyndall design team propose innovative circuits to meet the bio sensing application
Perform schematic design, simulation and analysis across PVT corners and relevant operating conditions
Work with guidance from experienced layout engineers to ensure effective layout implementation of analogue circuits, including matching, parasitics, shielding, grounding, isolation and other layout considerations
Prepare presentations and reports
Support project management
Participate in Education and Public Engagement activities, as required
Ensure compliance with Tyndall’s Quality Management Systems, Health and Safety standards, and other regulations
Carry out any additional duties as may reasonably be required within the general scope and level of the post
Essential Criteria
The successful candidate must have:
a MEng or equivalent experience (e.g. BEng + 2 years’ experience) in a relevant discipline such as electrical/electronic engineering, physics or related relevant discipline;
experience in designing integrated circuits in the areas of Analogue, Mixed-Signal or RF circuit design;
experience with designing and simulating integrated circuits using tools such as Cadence/Siemens-Mentor/Synoposys;
strong communication skills, as evidenced by prior experience such as working with/in industry, scientific paper writing, conference presentation and report writing
Knowledge of analogue circuits e.g. amplifiers or comparators
Knowledge of AI algorithms
Desirable Criteria
Knowledge of Integrated circuit layout
Good mathematical ability and knowledge of statistics
Experience programming with Python
What We Offer
Apart from offering a position in a highly successful and positive research environment, with a collaborative ethos full of diverse competencies to boost your career, we offer the following:
Impactful Work: Opportunities to contribute to ground-breaking research and innovation that shape Ireland’s economy and the society at large.
Continuous Learning: Strong support for formal training, further study and professional development.
Interdisciplinary Environment: Where academia, industry, and innovation intersect - supported by cutting-edge infrastructure and expert knowledge.
Blended Working: Flexibility to work remotely and on-site, where the role allows.
Comprehensive Benefits: Access to UCC pension, long-term illness benefit, life assurance, and more.
Generous Leave: Competitive annual leave entitlements.
Equity & Inclusion: Athena Swan Bronze award holder, with ongoing initiatives led by a dedicated People and Culture team to ensure equity for all.
Core Values: A culture grounded in Ambition, Collaboration, Diversity, Excellence, and Integrity.
Entrepreneurial Spirit: A proactive, innovation-driven environment that welcomes entrepreneurial and creative thinkers, including those with start-up experience.
Supportive Onboarding: Structured induction and mentoring to help new hires integrate and thrive.
Vibrant Culture: A collaborative, people-first workplace with a strong sense of community.
Terms of Employment
Contract Category: Full-Time
Contract Type: Fixed Term
The duration of the project is 7 months in the first instance, although this may be extended for an additional year pending funding and performance.
Appointment may be made on the Research Assistant Salary Scale i.e. €34,129- €44,311 per annum. Placement on appointment will be in accordance with public sector pay policy.
For further information, please contact to Dr. Daniel O' Hare.
Closing date of applications is 1pm, 16th October 2026.
Application Instructions
Please make sure to attach an up to date CV/Resume AND a brief motivation letter outlining how you meet the ‘Essential Criteria’ for this role.
Please note that Garda vetting and/or an international police clearance check may form part of the selection process.
At this time, Tyndall National Institute does not require the assistance of recruitment agencies.
Tyndall National Institute at University College, Cork is an Equal Opportunities Employer

jobs.title: Renewable Energy Analyst (Graduate)
jobs.desc:
Renewable Energy Analyst (Graduate)
Location:
Cork (hybrid)
Salary:
€45,000 - €55,000, depending on experience
Type:
Full-time, permanent
About us
We are a clean energy company that develops, builds, owns and operates renewable projects across the island of Ireland, with a portfolio spanning onshore wind, solar and battery energy storage (BESS). From our Cork office, our team supports projects across Munster and the wider island, in one of Europe's most exciting renewable energy markets. We are looking for a graduate analyst to help power that growth.
What you will do
You will work at the analytical heart of the business, supporting decisions across development, finance and operations. Expect variety, real responsibility and plenty of learning. Your work will include:
Building and maintaining models for project economics, energy production and market analysis
Conducting research on markets, policy, technologies and competitors to support strategic decisions
Supporting due diligence on new projects and acquisitions, working with data from every corner of the business
Analysing performance data from our operating fleet and reporting on trends and improvements
Preparing clear reports, dashboards and presentations for project teams and senior leadership
Supporting the development team with data for grid applications, planning and site selection
Improving the spreadsheets, tools and datasets the whole company relies on
What we are looking for
A degree (2.1 or above) in finance, economics, engineering, environmental science, data analytics or a related field
A genuine interest in renewable energy and the clean energy transition
Strong analytical skills and real comfort in Excel; experience with Python, SQL or data visualisation tools is an advantage
Attention to detail and the discipline to get the numbers right
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn analysis into insight
Initiative and curiosity: you take ownership, ask good questions and learn quickly
The right to work in Ireland
Internship or project experience in energy, finance or data analysis is an advantage but not essential. We hire for aptitude and attitude, and we invest in developing our people.
What we offer
€45,000 - €55,000 starting salary, depending on experience
Hybrid working from our Cork office
A structured development path with mentorship from experienced analysts and managers
Exposure to development, finance and operations across three technologies
Pension contributions, generous annual leave and wellbeing support
Support for professional development and further study
The chance to grow with a company building and operating real clean energy assets
How to apply
Apply with your CV and a short note on why this role interests you. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
We are an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Reasonable accommodations are available on request at any stage of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: ACG Global Commercialization Manager
jobs.desc:
Job Description
Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance the quality of life. We provide life science, diagnostic and applied market laboratories worldwide with instruments, services, consumables, applications and expertise. Agilent enables customers to gain the answers and insights they seek ---- so they can do what they do best: improve the world around us. Information about Agilent is available at www.agilent.com.
We are looking for a Global Commercialization Manager to support our product introduction for the Agilent CrossLab Group (ACG).
The Commercialization Manager will drive consistent commercialization success across our new and existing portfolio within ACG. In this critical role, you will lead and execute the successful launch of our cutting-edge products, ensuring they meet market demands and drive business growth. Your expertise in project management, market analysis, and cross-functional collaboration will be pivotal in delivering innovative solutions to scientists and researchers worldwide.
In this role you will partner directly with key stakeholders across multiple functions including Product Management, Commercial Marketing, Sales Channels, Business Operations, Training & Enablement and Product Support.
Key Responsibilities include:
Develop and implement comprehensive commercialization plans for new life science products, ensuring alignment with Agilent's goals and market needs
Lead and manage multiple launch projects simultaneously, ensuring timely execution, addressing commercialization requirements as per our commercialization playbook.
Lead the commercialization process and governance to drive consistency and efficiency in processes across the ACG organization
Lead division and Field engagements via planning and execution of commercialization milestone meetings to gain commitment on pricing and forecast
Hold multi-functional team accountable to the commercialization planning process to ensure the team meet objectives within the planned launch timeline
Train Product Managers on go to market process and provide consultation on the process
Ensure alignment across Product Management, Commercial Marketing, Field Sales, Training & Enablement to achieve a successful NPI launch and ramp to volume
Partner with Solution unit teams to develop content and insight messaging for new product introductions
Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to measure launch success, analyze performance data, and make data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement.
The role forms part of the wider Agilent Launch Excellence Team. Launch Excellence consists of Commercialization Managers, Channel Development Managers, as well as a Center of Excellence for optimizing our Commercialization playbook and building appropriate tools to support product launches across the Agilent Enterprise. As a key member of this team, you will partner with the Channel Development Manager to ensure Sales Channel readiness, conduct periodic post launch audits, spearhead commercialization process improvement opportunities, and actively participate on the Launch Excellence CoE.
Personal Attributes:
Proactive and self-motivated with a passion for driving commercial success
Adaptable and able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
Strong problem-solving skills and a keen attention to detail
Skills:
Strong project management and organizational skills
Excellent communication and presentation abilities
Proven ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment
Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make strategic decisions
Knowledge: Familiarity with requirements and standards within the life sciences industry.
Qualifications
Personal Attributes/Skills/Knowledge:
Proactive and self-motivated with a passion for driving commercial success
Adaptable and able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Broad scientific industry knowledge. Familiarity with requirements and standards within the industry.
Strong project management and organizational skills
Proven ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment with members from different geographies and cultures
Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make strategic decisions
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Job Posting Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's Degree or equivalent.
Post-graduate, certification, and/or license may be required.
Typically, at least 8+ years relevant experience for entry to this level in one or multiple areas including Product Marketing, Sales Channel, Commercial Marketing, Leading Cross Functional Projects.
Additional Details
This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least oktober 14, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.
The full-time equivalent pay range for this position is $135.840,00 - $212.250,00/yr plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations

jobs.desc:
At Crowleys DFK we recognise that it’s our people who make us who we are. We pride ourselves on our value-based culture which creates a caring, inclusive, innovative and collaborative environment – a culture where you can take your career to the next level. We celebrate the different skillsets, backgrounds, and talents in all our people and are always looking for experienced professionals to join our team.
If you want to work for a progressive and successful firm, one founded on teamwork and that offers you support at every stage of your career, then that firm is Crowleys DFK!

Competitive
compensation
package including excellent
benefits
.

,

Working structure,

y

About the opportunity:
Due to exciting and continued growth, our Payroll Services department are looking for an Assistant Manager to join their team. This position will be permanent, full-time, Hybrid(2 days in the office) and based in our Cork office.
Reporting to the Senior Payroll Manager, the Assistant Manager in Payroll Services will support the day-to-day operation of the Payroll Services Department, ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of payroll services to a diverse client portfolio.
This role combines payroll processing, people management, client relationship management and operational oversight. The successful candidate will take ownership of payroll delivery, support and develop team members, drive continuous improvement initiatives and help maintain the high standards of service expected by clients.
The ideal candidate will be technically strong, commercially aware and capable of working independently while providing day-to-day guidance, support and oversight to designated team members. They will be proactive in identifying and resolving issues before they impact clients or the business and will know when matters should be escalated to the Senior Payroll Manager.
Y
ou can expect your duties will primarily include:
Payroll Operations
Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly client payrolls accurately and on time.
Review team payroll outputs and ensure compliance with internal controls and quality standards.
Process timesheets, manual calculations and payroll adjustments.
Handle payroll-related queries with Revenue, pension providers and other third parties.
Calculate statutory payments, holiday and public holiday entitlements.
Ensure compliance with payroll legislation and best practice.
Team & Payroll Management
Supervise, support and develop Payroll Executives.
Manage the delivery of assigned payroll portfolios, ensuring deadlines and service standards are consistently achieved.
Assist with workload planning, resource allocation and payroll scheduling across the team.
Review work completed by team members and provide feedback, coaching and support where required.
Support the training, mentoring and ongoing development of Payroll Executives.
Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Client Management & Business Development
Build and maintain strong client relationships.
Act as an escalation point for payroll queries and issues.
Participate in client meetings and payroll reviews.
Prepare fee quotations and support new business opportunities.
Coordinate the onboarding of new payroll clients.
Technical & Operational Excellence
Develop and maintain expertise in payroll systems, reporting and data import processes.
Create, maintain and troubleshoot payroll reports and imports.
Act as a subject matter expert on payroll processes and systems.
Identify and implement process improvements and efficiencies.
Lead or participate in payroll-related projects and system enhancements.
Maintain process documentation and support knowledge sharing across the team.
Leadership & Risk Management
Take ownership of operational issues and drive them through to resolution.
Monitor the payroll inbox and ensure client queries are dealt with promptly.
Identify risks, issues and service concerns at an early stage.
Escalate matters appropriately and in a timely manner.
Act as deputy to the Senior Payroll Manager, assuming responsibility for the day-to-day management of the department during periods of absence.
Support the achievement of departmental objectives and service standards.
What we are looking for:
Essential
Certified Payroll Technician (IPASS) or Diploma in Payroll Management.
Minimum 5 years' experience processing Irish payrolls, ideally within a payroll bureau, outsourced payroll or multi-client environment.
Strong knowledge of Irish payroll legislation and Revenue requirements.
Strong experience working with payroll software and payroll processing systems; experience using Sage Micropay, MegaPay or equivalent payroll platforms would be a distinct advantage.
Previous experience supervising, mentoring or coordinating the work of other team members.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Excellent organisational, communication and problem-solving skills.
Strong client relationship management skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
Ability to manage assignments from start to finish with minimal supervision
Excellent client service and stakeholder management skills.
Desirable
Public sector payroll experience.
Experience managing client onboarding and payroll implementations.
Experience creating payroll reports, imports and validation processes.
Experience identifying and implementing process improvements.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative, Mid-Market (EMEA)
jobs.desc:
Keeper is hiring a driven, Inside Sales Representative to join our high producing global sales team. Qualified candidates must permanently reside in Ireland. This is a hybrid position for those living within a commutable distance to our Cork, Ireland office, or fully remote for those living outside a commutable distance.
Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organisations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and gain valuable skills while building new client relationships in this pivotal role!
About Keeper
Keeper Security is a leading cybersecurity software company that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in more than 150 countries. Keeper delivers a powerful zero-trust and zero-knowledge solution built to meet the stringent requirements of public sector IT environments. Its flagship offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects users, devices and critical infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized in the Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper combines robust compliance with unmatched visibility and control. With industry-leading certifications, Keeper provides the security assurance public sector organizations require. Learn why agencies trust Keeper to defend against today’s sophisticated adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.
About The Role
At Keeper, the Inside Sales Account Representatives are responsible for driving new business within an assigned geography or vertical. This is a quota carrying and revenue generating position that reports to our Manager of Inside Sales. This role involves complex selling within a sales cycle period. You will gain a deep understanding of our frontline sales strategies while creating a vision that inspires customers to utilize Keeper as a trusted resource.
Responsibilities
Thrive in a supportive but independent workplace with the opportunity to grow as our organization grows
Target new customers through cold outreach and lead generation campaigns via phone calls and emails
Manage the full sales cycle from initial contact through to closing, ensuring accurate forecasting and reporting
Balance scheduling sales meetings with new clients on a weekly basis
Ensure all customers are on an active Keeper contract
Build and create a constant pipeline of prospect customers to scope
Act as a subject matter expert on all Keeper products, staying knowledgeable and informed of changes, updates, and new products
Participate in cold call/role play activities and shadow cold calls with colleagues
Develop relationships with prospect customer contacts
Utilize additional sales resources to target and identify new business targets
Leverage Salesforce.com database to accurately reflect pipeline and account activity
Facilitate the proposal review process for new business opportunities
Requirements
3+ years of software sales experience
Experience selling identity access management solutions, including PAM (privileged access management)
An accomplished track record of selling software into IT organisations
Salesforce experience
Web-conference demo experience
A track record of exceeding sales quotas
A positive mindset, team-oriented, results driven, and organised
Deadline and detail oriented
Experience managing full sales cycle
Preferred
Bachelor’s degree
Cybersecurity experience
Experience or knowledge of the Information Security industry is highly desired
Excellent problem-solving skills
Proficiency with Microsoft Office & Google Suite programs
Experience working with a Customer Relationship Management tool is preferred, expertise with Salesforce.com is highly desired
Benefits
Onsite lunches
Private healthcare (no wait period)
Pension contribution (no wait period)
Sick Pay
Bike-to-Work Scheme (if local)
Keeper is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.desc:
Company Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
Department Overview
At Motorola Solutions, we're guided by a shared purpose—helping people be their best in the moments that matter. We live up to our purpose every day by solving for safer, building mission-critical communications devices and networks, AI-powered video security, and integrated command center views. The work we do connects public safety agencies and enterprises to enable vital collaboration when it matters the most.
Our RFSite Software Engineering organization, a key component of the Critical Communications Networks business segment, consists of a diverse group of software engineers, product architects, system architects, and test engineers across global locations.
We leverage the latest virtualization technologies on a robust Linux platform, following modern software development practices such as Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD), DevOps, and automated testing. Operating within Agile/Scrum methodologies, our team is responsible for the end-to-end software development lifecycle of next-generation Radio Frequency (RF) Site solutions.
Job Description
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join an Agile Scrum team developing containerized Linux user-space applications and services for mission-critical land mobile radio communications products.
In this role, you will focus on writing high-quality modern Python services deployed in container environments and leveraging AI tools/technologies to accelerate development, while interfacing with and debugging existing C++ subsystems. You will apply solid Linux OS and networking fundamentals, leverage multiple automated testing frameworks, and work in an RF telecommunications context alongside modern CI/CD tooling.
Key Responsibilities
Containerized Service Development: Design, implement, and maintain Linux user-space applications using modern Python constructs within containerized environments.
AI Tooling & Integration: Utilize approved AI-assisted development tools and integrate AI/ML capabilities or automated analytics into engineering workflows where applicable.
Linux OS & Networking: Develop networking applications utilizing socket programming, network protocol handling (TCP/IP, UDP), and Linux OS user-space interactions.
Automated Testing Ecosystem: Build and expand test suites for unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
System Interfacing & Debugging: Read, interface with, and debug lower-level legacy or embedded C/C++ codebases and APIs.
RF & Telecommunications Context: Work with RF domain concepts, radio infrastructure, and network protocols during product integration.
CI/CD & Quality Assurance: Integrate code into automated build pipelines and enforce code quality standards using static analysis.
On-Site Lab Testing: Engage in hands-on testing, configuration, and debugging across virtualized environments and physical RF site equipment/network gear.
Basic Requirements
Education & Experience
Bachelor’s (BS) degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field with relevant software engineering experience, OR
Master’s (MS) degree with relevant work experience.
Primary Language: Demonstrated proficiency in software development using modern Python.
Linux OS & Networking: Strong understanding of Linux operating system concepts, user-space architecture, and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, sockets, network protocols).
Containers: Practical experience with Linux user-space development and containerization platforms.
Automated Testing: Hands-on experience automated testing frameworks.
C/C++ Knowledge: Ability to read, interface with, and debug C/C++ codebases.
Desired Skills & Experience
Exposure to AI/ML tools (e.g., AI coding assistants, prompt engineering for developer tooling, or integration of AI APIs/frameworks).
Familiarity or background in RF / Telecommunications / Land Mobile Radio (LMR) systems.
Experience with CI/CD tools and static code analysis tools.
Version control and task management using Git and Jira.
Experience with network diagnostic tools.
Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills in a cross-functional team.
Work Model: On-Site.
Environment: Direct access to modern containerized Linux server environments alongside physical RF test lab facilities.

None

None

Experienced

Yes

THE OPPORTUNITY
We have an exciting opportunity for a skilled and motivated Hydrologist to join our growing water and environment team at Stantec. You will play a key role in delivering hydrological assessments and technical inputs across a wide range of infrastructure, water, and development projects, with excellent opportunities to develop your career within a multidisciplinary environment.
About The Role
This is a strong opportunity to join a growing and well-established water and environment team at a time of continued expansion, where you can make a meaningful impact on a diverse portfolio of infrastructure, water, and development projects. As part of a multidisciplinary organisation, you will gain exposure to a broad range of technical challenges while collaborating with experts across engineering, environmental, and planning disciplines.
You will have the chance to take ownership of key hydrological assessments, contribute to high-profile projects, and develop your expertise in flood risk management, drainage, and environmental reporting within the Irish regulatory framework. The role offers a clear pathway for career progression, supported by ongoing professional development, mentoring, and opportunities to expand your technical and project management skills.
Being part of a larger international organisation provides access to global best practices, innovative tools, and a wide professional network, while still maintaining a strong local presence and project focus. This is an ideal role for someone looking to advance their career in hydrology, deepen their technical capabilities, and contribute to sustainable water management and climate resilience solutions.
YOUR IMPACT
In this role, you will play a key part in shaping how water is managed across a variety of projects, helping to ensure that development is both sustainable and resilient to future climate challenges. Your work will directly inform critical decisions around flood risk, drainage design, and environmental protection, influencing outcomes for communities, infrastructure, and natural ecosystems.
By delivering robust hydrological assessments and clear, evidence-based insights, you will support clients and project teams in navigating complex regulatory requirements and achieving successful project approvals. Your input will contribute to reducing flood risk, improving water quality, and promoting sustainable development practices across Ireland.
You will also strengthen collaboration within multidisciplinary teams, bringing a hydrology perspective that enhances overall project quality and innovation. Through your technical expertise and proactive approach, you will help drive high standards, build client confidence, and contribute to the continued growth and reputation of the team.
About You
You are a motivated hydrology professional with experience in surface water assessments, data analysis, and environmental reporting within the Irish regulatory context. You have a solid understanding of flood risk management, drainage design principles, and relevant legislation and guidance. With strong analytical, communication, and report-writing skills, you work effectively both independently and as part of multidisciplinary teams. You are enthusiastic about sustainable water management and committed to delivering high-quality technical outputs that support positive environmental outcomes.
Your Technical Skills Include
Undertaking hydrological assessments including flood risk assessments (FRA), drainage impact assessments, and surface water studies.
Collecting, analysing, and interpreting hydrological and meteorological data.
Supporting the preparation of technical reports and environmental submissions, including EIAR inputs and regulatory assessments.
Contributing to project scoping, planning, and programming activities.
You are adaptable and capable of managing challenging workloads under changing priorities, delivering high-quality results in a dynamic environment.
WHY JOIN US
We put people first: We're proud of our friendly, inclusive and collaborative environment where everyone feels valued and driven to succeed.
We are driven to achieve: Named in the top 50 companies to work by Glassdoor 2025. Recognised by Corporate Knights as one of the world's top 10 most sustainable companies 2025. =

We are better together: A supportive and collaborative team environment to assist with the growth of your career.
Growth: We're on an exciting growth journey across the Ireland - we want you to be part of it!
Great Benefits: Competitive salary, enhanced pension plan, annual leave with the option to buy/sell additional days, private medical insurance, group income protection & life assurance included as standard!

Whether you’re starting out on your engineering career or are looking for a fresh challenge, Ryan Hanley, now part of Stantec, is a great career move.
Based in Dublin, Galway, Castlebar and Cork, we are actively recruiting for team players with experience in any of the following areas – water and wastewater treatment process and network design, integrated network management, structural design, site development, road and bridge engineering, project management and administration.
You’ll be working for a dynamic company with an excellent reputation in the industry.

DePuy Synthes is establishing a standalone Orthopaedics company. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months of the original announcement date of October 2025, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals.
Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes, and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.
DePuy Synthes, a ~$9 billion business, has an outstanding opportunity for a Senior Finance Manager operating within Supply Chain Finance to gain extensive exposure across DePuy Synthes Principal Operations while leading the Currency Management team.
Role Overview
In this role, you will provide financial leadership to the Currency Management team, leading the identification and management of foreign currency exposures, centralized hedging, hedge and inventory accounting, forecasting, analytics and reporting across DePuy Synthes.
You will play a critical role in standing up the group to operate as a standalone DePuy Synthes Principal Operations team, ensuring that essential currency management activities continue to be performed to the highest standards of compliance, accuracy and insight before, during and after separation.
The immediate focus of the role will be to stand up the Currency Management team and its operating model; establish the end-to-end exposure identification, hedge submission, accounting and control processes required to support placement of hedges through a third-party provider; and lead the development and ongoing maintenance of replacement calculation and analytics capabilities as existing systems will not be available to DePuy Synthes following separation.
Key Responsibilities
Lead, coach and develop a global team of three finance professionals.
Serve as the first point of contact for currency-related topics and questions across DePuy Synthes.
Lead the identification and management of foreign currency exposures, including centralized forecasting and balance sheet hedging, and establish the process required to place hedges with a third-party provider.
Ensure accurate and compliant hedge and inventory accounting in line with US GAAP and relevant accounting procedures.
Lead the calculation, analysis, reporting and communication of actual and forecast transactional currency impacts across DePuy Synthes P&L lines, including driver-based variance analysis, trends, risks and opportunities.
Provide currency analytics, insights and recommendations to DSPO, FP&A, Treasury and senior management.
Lead regular currency and hedge-result reviews with business partners and senior leadership and provide training and educational materials to strengthen understanding of currency and hedging principles across DePuy Synthes.
Lead the design, build, testing and deployment of a replacement tool to support currency calculations, hedging, analytics and reporting, and oversee its ongoing maintenance and enhancement.
Drive standardized and efficient processes through automation and analytics tools, including Power BI and Alteryx.
Partner across DSPO, Treasury, Tax, FP&A, Technology and Project Osprey teams to stand up the Currency Management team and ensure continuity of critical activities through separation.
Qualifications And Experience
Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably with a major in Accounting, Economics or Finance; a Master’s degree, MBA or recognized financial qualification such as ACA, ACCA or CIMA is preferred.
Minimum of 7 years of finance, accounting or related business experience.
Demonstrated leadership capability, with the ability to develop others, support organizational health and remove barriers to success.
Strong analytical skills and proven ability to bring clarity to complex business issues, manage complex projects and processes, and translate complexity into practical solutions.
Excellent communication and business partnering skills, including the ability to frame complex data, simplify written communications, influence internal customers and work effectively with all management levels.
Confident presenting to senior management, facilitating discussion and providing clear recommendations and solutions.
Ability to operate independently in a dynamic, high-visibility global environment, manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively across a virtual matrix organization.
Strong continuous improvement mindset; Supply Chain experience and proficiency with TMI, Alteryx or Power BI are preferred.
Demonstrated understanding of AI concepts and frameworks, including awareness of responsible and ethical AI practices, and has experience generating effective prompts to boost efficiency and productivity.
Leadership Capabilities
Leads and develops talent through coaching, delegation and clear accountability.
Builds trusted relationships and influences effectively across a global organization.
Combines strategic thinking with strong execution, prioritization and attention to detail.
Demonstrates integrity, resilience and a strong continuous improvement mindset.
Our Culture of Inclusion
Our Credo guides our commitment to an inclusive work environment where every person is respected as an individual. We value different abilities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives, and we want every colleague to belong, thrive and reach their potential.

Creates an environment that encourages innovation and personal growth
Role models a culture where customers love to shop and colleagues love to work

You will be responsible for
Always put the customer first and consider them in everything you do.
Get to know your customers and serve them with pride.
Help to ensure products and services are available for customers at all times.
Handle all products with care to maintain quality and ensure they reach the customer in the best condition.
Keep the shop floor and back areas clean and tidy at all times.
Using the training you receive, follow department routines and processes.
Follow all company policies and adhere to Health and Safety routines.
Whilst you will have a core role, you may be asked to support your colleagues by helping in other departments.
You will need
EXPERIENCE
Must have previous management experience
For the ‘Line Manager’ role you have a demonstrated track record of:
Being passionate about delivering  the right way for customers and colleagues
Being adaptable and agile in your thinking
Delivering key objectives in a fast paced environment
Being the ‘Go To’ person for all queries for your department
Shaping and influencing at the most senior level

LEADERSHIP SKILLS & STYLE
You make time to build strong relationships with colleagues inside and outside of my store. I work collaboratively with my team to deliver results
You are warm and welcoming in every interaction with colleagues and customers – putting people at the heart of everything that I do. I take time to see hear and recognise others. Colleagues see me being myself, sharing my passion and enthusiasm
You use energy and resilience to keep momentum going when working in challenging environments. I make tough decisions when there is no right answer, staying true to my personal values
Your colleagues see me doing the right things when things are going well and when times are tough. I know how to be at my best and inspire confidence in those around me
You encourage others to think differently, providing an environment where creativity and new ideas are welcomed. I am keen to help deliver new initiatives, providing feedback on how they could be further improved
A humble leader who lives the Tesco’s values
Whats in it for you?
We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren’t limited to:
Competitive Salary from €37,500
Bonus Scheme*
Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost.
24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life.
Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2
nd
Clubcard available.*
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*
Save As You Earn Scheme*
Paid Family Leave
Bike to Work
Long Service Awards
Commuter Scheme
*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply
About Us
Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer’s favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move.  Our core purpose is “Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day”.  Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers.  It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children’s Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated.   At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings.  We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best.
We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.

Talent Acquisition: Liz Oliver, liz.oliver@atlascopco.com

Edwards is a leading developer and manufacturer of sophisticated vacuum products, exhaust management systems and related value-added services. The role would provide dedicated ownership for implementing and sustaining 6S across laboratories areas. Key accountabilities would include programme coordination, workplace assessments, visual standards, audits, action tracking, training, coaching and performance reporting.
The position is proposed as an individual-contributor role . The preferred candidate would have experience in a regulated operational environment, practical 5S or 6S knowledge and strong change-management and facilitation skills.
The role would help strengthen safety, improve workplace organisation and operational flow, and ensure that 6S becomes embedded in daily working practices.
The Operational Excellence 6S Specialist will lead and support the implementation, standardisation and ongoing sustainability of 6S across BCoE laboratories.
6S builds upon the principles of Sort, Set in Order, Shine, Standardise and Sustain, with Safety integrated throughout. The role will help create safe, compliant, efficient and visually managed workplaces that enable colleagues to perform their work effectively and consistently.
This position will partner closely with laboratory teams, scientists, engineers, Environmental Health and Safety,Facilities and BCoE leadership.
The successful candidate will combine practical workplace organisation experience with strong facilitation, coaching, data analysis and change-management skills.
The role supports the organisation’s Operational Excellence expectation that employees actively participate in problem-solving and continuous improvement, while leaders establish improvement goals that make processes more efficient and agile in a compliant manner

jobs.title: Principal Design Engineer
jobs.desc:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.
Cadence is a pivotal leader in electronic design, building upon more than 30 years of computational software expertise. The company applies its underlying Intelligent System Design strategy to deliver software, hardware and IP that turn design concepts into reality.
Cadence customers are the world’s most innovative companies, delivering extraordinary electronic products from chips to boards to systems for the most dynamic market applications including consumer, hyperscale computing, 5G communications, automotive, aerospace industrial and health.

Job Title: Principal Digital Design Engineer
Location: Munich, Cork, Katowice, Edinburgh
Reports to:
Senior Principal Engineer
The Role
We are seeking an exceptional Principal Digital Design Engineer to join the Performance Solutions Group (PSG).
The candidate will contribute to the development of complex, high-performance semiconductor designs.
You will work as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team, developing and integrating RTL for advanced SoCs and silicon platforms. You will be involved throughout the front-end design process, from understanding architectural requirements and developing microarchitectures through RTL implementation, simulation, synthesis, and handoff to downstream teams.
This is a hands-on engineering role suited to someone who enjoys solving challenging technical problems, learning new technologies, and working across the boundaries between architecture, RTL, verification, and physical implementation.
Key Responsibilities
Design, implement, and integrate high-quality synthesizable RTL using SystemVerilog.
Translate architectural specifications into robust, efficient microarchitectures and RTL implementations.
Work with architects and senior engineers to understand functional and performance requirements.
Develop RTL that meets requirements for performance, power, area, and functionality.
Participate in RTL design reviews and contribute to design methodology and coding standards.
Develop and maintain unit-level and block-level test environments in collaboration with verification engineers.
Debug functional issues using simulation, waveform analysis, assertions, and other verification tools.
Work with verification teams to identify, reproduce, and resolve RTL design issues.
Collaborate with physical design engineers to understand and address timing, area, power, and implementation constraints.
Support synthesis, timing analysis, linting, CDC analysis, and other front-end quality checks.
Contribute to integration of internally developed and third-party IP.
Help investigate and resolve issues encountered during integration and downstream implementation.
Document design decisions, interfaces, microarchitecture, implementation details and reviews within the PSG Quality Management System (QMS)
Contribute to continuous improvement of RTL methodologies, automation, and development flows.
Work alongside senior engineers to develop solutions to challenging customer and internal silicon problems.
Technical Scope
Depending On Experience, The Role May Encompass Areas Including
SystemVerilog RTL
SoC and subsystem design
CPU, GPU, AI/ML, networking, or other high-performance compute architectures
Control logic and datapaths
Memory interfaces and controllers
High-speed interfaces
Clock and reset architectures
AMBA protocols such as AXI, AHB, and APB
IP integration
Low-power design techniques
Assertions and formal verification
RTL synthesis and optimization
Static analysis, lint, and CDC
Performance and power optimization
RTL-to-gates implementation flows
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
10+ years of relevant RTL/ASIC design experience.
Proficiency in Verilog or SystemVerilog.
Understanding of digital logic design and synchronous design principles.
Experience developing synthesizable RTL for ASIC or FPGA implementations.
Familiarity with simulation and RTL debugging.
Understanding of common SoC interfaces and protocols.
Basic understanding of synthesis, timing, and physical implementation considerations.
Ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop practical solutions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team.
Ability to communicate effectively to customers
What Success Looks Like
Deliver robust RTL. Develop clean, maintainable, synthesizable RTL that meets functional and performance requirements.
Think beyond the RTL. Understand how design decisions affect verification, synthesis, timing, power, area, and ultimately silicon.
Solve problems independently. Take ownership of assigned blocks and issues while knowing when to seek guidance from more senior engineers.
Work collaboratively. Build strong working relationships with architects, verification, physical design, and other Silicon Engineering teams.
Learn quickly. Develop expertise in new architectures, technologies, methodologies, and Cadence tools as projects evolve.
Grow into technical leadership. Develop the depth and breadth needed to take ownership of increasingly complex blocks and eventually lead technical areas within the Silicon Engineering organisation.
Why Join the PSG Team?
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced semiconductor technology, EDA, and real silicon.
You will work on problems that are often at the limits of what current design methodologies and technologies can achieve, collaborating with some of the world's leading semiconductor companies and technology partners.
Rather than being limited to a single product or stage of the design flow, you will have the opportunity to influence the entire path from technology and methodology through to working silicon.
If you are an engineer who wants to solve the industry's hardest silicon problems—and see those solutions become real products—this is the team for you.
Additional Information
Cadence is committed to equal employment opportunity and employment equity throughout all levels of the organization. We strive to attract a qualified and diverse candidate pool and encourage diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
Travel:
<10%
We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.

jobs.title: STA Design Engineer - ASIC / Low Power
jobs.desc:
STA Design Engineer - ASIC / Low Power
We are partnered with a global leader in semiconductors and wireless technology focused on developing high-performance, low-power ASIC solutions for advanced cores and SOCs (System-on-Chips). The team are looking to hire an STA Engineer to take responsibility for conducting complex timing signoff activities and drive closure for next-generation products.
This is a permanent working opportunity based in Cork, Ireland.
Key responsibilities for this STA Design Engineer position:
Perform Static Timing Analysis (STA) and drive timing closure for complex cores and full-chip SOCs (e.g., in the Snapdragon family).
Evaluate block-level and top-level timing on gate-level PNR netlists.
Provide critical feedback to the RTL, Synthesis, and Physical Design teams to improve Power, Performance, and Area (PPA).
Create and execute Timing Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) to resolve critical timing violations.
Enhance techniques and methodologies for timing closure and STA flow accuracy to reduce turnaround time (TAT).
Develop automation scripts (Python, TCL, or Perl) for timing/power data mining and processing.
Key requirements:
4+ years of related work experience in Static Timing Analysis.
Expert proficiency in STA tools such as PrimeTime, PrimeShield, or Tempus for hierarchical analysis in large SoCs.
Hands-on experience with ECO tools (e.g., Tweaker, PrimeClosure, PTECO, Tempus ECO) for timing closure.
Highly proficient in automation scripting using Python, TCL, or Perl.
Strong knowledge of the complete ASIC design flow (RTL-to-GDS).
Keywords:
STA Design Engineer / Static Timing Analysis / STA / Timing Closure / ASIC Design / SOC / PrimeTime / Tempus / Timing ECO / PPA Optimization / Gate-Level Netlist / Python / TCL / Physical Design / RTL / Synthesis / Semiconductor / High-Performance Cores

Company Description
JSM Heating Solutions Ltd is a locally based plumbing and heating company with over 15 years of experience serving commercial and domestic clients throughout the Cork area. Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with strong time management and problem-solving skills.
Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel within the Cork Metropolitan Area for service calls.

jobs.title: Human Resources And Employment Services Manager
jobs.desc:
Company Description
South Tipperary Development company (STDC) is a community-led local development company and registered charity working with individuals, families, communities and businesses throughout South Tipperary. Governed by a voluntary Board of Directors, STDC is managed by a Senior Management Team led by the Chief Executive Officer and currently comprising the Chief Executive Officer, Financial Controller and Social Inclusion Programme Manager.
STDC employs 42 core staff and 170 participants between the Tús programme and Rural Social Scheme. STDC delivers a diverse portfolio of employment services, labour market activation, social inclusion, rural and community development, health and wellbeing, integration and rural recreation programmes.
Purpose of the Role
This is a newly created senior management position at a pivotal stage in STDC’s development. The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping the organisation’s workforce, supporting and developing staff, promoting a positive work environment, strengthening organisational capacity and contributing to the delivery of employment and progression service programmes. The post offers an opportunity to influence both people strategy and service delivery as a member of the Senior Management Team.
The role involves the following key elements:
Human Resources
In association with the board and the CEO, the postholder will be responsible for recruitment, employee relations, staff development, promoting a positive working environment, policy development and employment law compliance, and ensuring that the organisation has the staffing capacity required to deliver its programmes into the future.
Employment Services
The postholder will manage assigned Employment Services programmes (e.g. LAES, Tús, Community Employment) with responsibility for programme delivery, staff performance, compliance and achievement of agreed targets.
Key Responsibilities
1. Human Resources
In association with the board and CEO, lead and manage STDC’s Human Resources function.
Ensure compliance with employment legislation, HR policies and organisational procedures.
Lead workforce planning, succession planning and the identification of future staffing and skills requirements.
Support Senior Management Team (SMT) in dealing with employee relations, performance, grievance and disciplinary matters.
Advise the Chief Executive Officer and Senior Management Team on employee and workforce matters and employment legislation.
Develop and implement a formal HR strategy aligned with organisational objectives
Oversee recruitment, induction, probation and staff exit processes.
Identify organisational training needs and lead the implementation of organisation-wide staff development programmes.
Ensure HR records, contracts, HR systems and workforce information are accurate, up-to-date and compliant.
2. Employment Services
Manage assigned Employment Services programmes e.g. LAES, Tús, etc
Lead, manage and support assigned programme staff, ensuring effective performance, development and accountability.
Monitor programme performance, compliance and achievement of agreed targets.
Ensure programmes operate in accordance with funder, contractual and organisational requirements.
Build and maintain relationships with funders, partners and other stakeholders.
Prepare programme reports, returns and funding claims as required.
Provide reports to the CEO and board as requested
3. Promote Positive Working Environment
Take a lead role in initiatives aimed at promoting and supporting positive working relations, including e.g. Employee assistance programme and wellbeing initiatives
Oversee the implementation of the Dignity at Work policy of STDC, working to ensure compliance and address any non-compliance.
4. Senior Management Team Responsibilities
Contribute to the work of the SMT
Support organisational planning, policy development and service improvement.
Support auditing, monitoring and quality assurances processes
Maintain accurate documentation and records in line with GDPR and regulatory requirements
Prepare reports and papers for the Board and CEO as requested
Represent STDC on various forums / committees as requested
Essential Requirements
Candidates must demonstrate:
A Level 8 qualification in Human Resource Management, Management, Business, Organisational Development or a related discipline.
Significant experience in human resource management and employee relations.
Strong knowledge of Irish employment legislation and HR best practice.
Experience managing programmes, projects or services and delivering agreed outcomes.
Experience advising and supporting managers on performance management, attendance management, grievance and disciplinary matters.
Experience leading recruitment, induction, probation and staff development processes.
Experience developing, implementing and reviewing HR policies and procedures.
Experience managing confidential and sensitive employment matters.
Experience preparing reports, recommendations and briefing papers for senior management and/or boards.
Experience managing staff and leading teams.
Strong leadership, communication, influencing and interpersonal skills.
Ability to operate effectively as a member of a Senior Management Team and contribute to organisational planning and decision-making.
Excellent organisational, administrative and IT skills.
Full driving licence and access to transport.
Desirable Requirements
Relevant level 9 professional qualification and/or membership of the Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development (CIPD).
Experience working in the community, voluntary, charitable or local development sector.
Experience of publicly funded programmes and services.
Experience managing employment, labour market activation or progression services.
Knowledge of Employment programmes such as Local Area Employment Services, Tús and Community Employment Scheme.
Experience working with Government departments, statutory agencies and programme funders.
Experience supporting Boards of Directors and Board sub-committees.
Experience in organisational development, service improvement or change management.
Experience using HR, CRM or workforce information systems.
Salary and Conditions
Competitive salary aligned to senior management roles within the local development sector and commensurate with qualifications and experience.
30 days annual leave (per Calander year)
Contributory pension benefits
Mileage paid at public service rates
Flexible / hybrid working arrangements
Professional Development Support
Access to Employee Assistance Programme
Supportive organisational culture
Additional Information
Equal Opportunities
South Tipperary Development Company CLG is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to promoting equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, race, membership of the Traveller community or socio-economic background.
Garda Vetting
The successful candidate may be required to complete Garda Vetting and/or provide satisfactory references prior to appointment.
References
Appointment to this position will be subject to the satisfactory receipt of references.
Data Protection
Any personal data submitted as part of the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with STDC’s Data Protection Policy and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and will be used solely for recruitment purposes.
Right to Work
The successful candidate must have the legal right to work in Ireland and provide appropriate documentation if requested.
Shortlisting
Shortlisting may apply. Canvassing will automatically disqualify.

jobs.title: Mechanic - Naval Service: Direct Entry - Engine Room Artificer
jobs.desc:
The Naval Service is the State's principal seagoing agency with a general responsibility to meet contingent and actual maritime defence requirements.
We are now recruiting qualified Maintenance Engineers and Technicians to join as Direct Entry Engine Room Artificers (ERAs). In this role, you'll maintain and repair critical onboard systems including propulsion, power generation and auxiliary machinery. Duties include preventative maintenance, fault diagnosis and participation in emergency response operations at sea.
About the Role:
The Naval Engine Room Artificer (ERA) is responsible for maintaining, repairing and ensuring the efficient operation of ship propulsion systems, power generation and auxiliary machinery
This role requires technical expertise in mechanical and electrical systems, problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure in a maritime environment.
ERAs play a vital role in ensuring operational readiness and safety at sea, contributing to the Irish Naval Service’s mission of maritime security and defence.
You will be responsible for conducting planned maintenance and defect rectification on propulsion, electrical and fluid systems.
You will diagnose faults and carry out troubleshooting procedures to ensure continuous operation.
You will assist in emergency response situations, including firefighting and damage control duties.
The role of the ERA works closely with engineering teams to ensure operational efficiency and safety compliance while maintaining accurate records of maintenance, repairs and part replacements.
Eligibility Requirements:
Educational/Professional Qualifications:
HETAC Level 7 in Marine or Mechanical Engineering
QQI Advanced Certificate Craft in:
Mechanical Automation & Maintenance Fitting
Diesel Fitting
Motor Mechanics
Department of Marine & Natural Resources Engineer Officer of the Watch (EOOW) Certificate of Competency
Applicants must be 18 years of age and under 39 years of age: you will be required to provide proof of your age if you progress to the next stage of the competition.
You must be at least 5ft 2in (157.48cm) in height. You will be measured during the selection process.
No tattoos are to be visible above the collar while serving in the Defence Forces. This will be checked during the selection process and you may not proceed if you have visible tattoos above your collar.
Applicants must meet the work permit eligibility criteria to serve as part of the Defence Forces. i.e. You must have a minimum of 5 years eligibility to stay in Ireland. You will be requested to provide proof of working permit on your application.
You must meet medical, physical and security clearance standards, which will be assessed during the recruitment process.
Base Location across: Naval Base, Haulbowline Island, Cork.

Glanua is an industry leader in providing innovative and sustainable engineering solutions to design, build, operate and maintain critical water and wastewater infrastructure across Ireland and the UK. We are a trusted delivery partner to the municipal and industrial sector, and our clients include some of the largest water utilities in Ireland and the UK, including Uisce Éireann (formerly Irish Water), Thames Water, Yorkshire Water and Affinity Water.
We are passionate about solving today's environmental challenges and delivering a decarbonised, sustainable world. We are a team of 600+ people across Ireland, the UK and Portugal and are rapidly expanding across several disciplines to meet our ambitious growth plans.
The Role
We are looking for an experienced Senior Automation & Controls Engineer to join our Automation Team at senior level. You will design, programme and deliver PLC, HMI and SCADA solutions for water treatment, wastewater treatment and energy projects across Ireland and the UK, covering greenfield plants and major upgrades involving technologies such as RO, MBR, SBR, MBBR, DAF, tertiary treatment, sludge handling, network telemetry and pumping stations.
This is a hands-on, full-lifecycle role combining technical delivery with strategic package management: tendering, functional design, software development, FAT, on-site control systems commissioning and testing, SAT and handover. You will own the automation and EC&I scope on assigned projects, acting as the technical lead and primary interface between the client, our project teams, and external Automation System Integrators (SIs), panel builders and instrumentation suppliers. You will work inside a multi-disciplinary team alongside process, mechanical, electrical and project management colleagues, in a genuine "one team" culture, with the autonomy to develop ideas, shape internal standards and introduce new technology. This breadth gives exposure to municipal water and wastewater, industrial treatment, operations-focused delivery and renewable energy / biogas projects. Proven competence on at least one major PLC platform: Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider or Mitsubishi.

Hands-on experience commissioning VSDs and instrumentation, and integrating them into control systems.
Strong on-site commissioning track record for automated control systems, including PLC/SCADA loop checkout, end-to-end I/O testing, control loop commissioning, plant start-up and client handover.
Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols: EtherNet/IP, Profinet, Profibus, Modbus TCP/IP, Modbus RTU, DeviceNet.
Experience producing FDS, SDS, FAT and SAT documentation to international standards.
Knowledge of applicable codes and regulations; experience working to UK / EU / IEC standards is an advantage.
Excellent problem-solving, fault-finding and analytical skills, with the ability to use your own initiative when issues arise during project delivery.
Strong written and verbal English, comfortable presenting technical solutions to clients and chairing review meetings.

Experience integrating to enterprise SCADA / historian environments (e.g. AVEVA Historian, PI System).
